jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Project Coordinator**

**Corporate Marketing | Ecosystem Alliances Program Office**

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

The Project Coordinator is a highly visible, detail-oriented role within the Corporate Marketing Ecosystem Alliances Program Office. Working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, this position supports cross-functional teams by coordinating critical processes, maintaining accurate records, and managing sensitive data associated with strategic customer engagements and ecosystem partnership programs.

**Core Areas of Responsibility**

* **IP Core Transmittal and third-party data access:** Coordinate the IP Core Transmittal process and maintain employee access status related to third-party data.
* **Program data and records management:** Maintain comprehensive records for ecosystem partnerships and product interoperability programs, with a strong focus on data integrity, security, and compliance.

**Key** **Responsibilities**

* Enter, maintain, and validate data related to employee access to third-party information in support of key customer engagements.
* Apply detailed procedures to track and document requests, approvals, restrictions, and status changes in support of compliance requirements.
* Adhere to internal policies and collaborate with cross-functional teams to maintain complete and accurate records.
* Coordinate a broad range of requests across multiple departments with professionalism, responsiveness, and sound judgment.
* Maintain records, files, and databases while safeguarding the confidentiality, security, and accuracy of sensitive information.
* Partner closely with the Corporate Marketing Ecosystem Alliances Program Project Manager to support efficient and effective program operations.
* Manage admission and renewal processes for Connections Program members, ensuring product-flow accuracy and tracking approvals with Product Marketing management teams.
* Maintain a high degree of accuracy across complex departmental and corporate order-entry databases.

**Required Qualifications and Capabilities**

* Exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and efficiency, with the ability to prioritize a high volume of requests in a dynamic environment.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent tasks and processes, including variations within standardized procedures.
* Dependable, self-directed work style and a demonstrated commitment to continuous learning.
* Comfort working through ambiguity and making decisions within defined parameters.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion when handling sensitive information.
* Ability to adapt solutions to business needs, recommend process improvements, and resolve challenges thoughtfully and creatively.
* Demonstrated success solving complex problems through a positive, collaborative approach.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong interpersonal effectiveness across functions.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Microsoft Office, FileMaker Pro, and Salesforce.
* Associate degree required, Bachelor degree preferred

**Work Authorization and Export Compliance**

Current authorization to work in the United States is required. Because this role may involve access to export-controlled technology or information, employment eligibility and access permissions will be evaluated in accordance with applicable U.S. export-control laws and company policy.

**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**

jobs.company: Community School of Music and Arts
jobs.title: Community Arts Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

The Community Arts Program Coordinator assists the Community Programs team in delivering high-quality programming to CSMA’s partners. Reporting to the Director of Community Programs, this role provides day-to-day administrative support for the Community Arts Programs, including: In-School Programs (Art4Schools, Music4Schools, After School), Artistic Intelligence, Mohr Gallery Community Artist Exhibitions and Events, and Community Events.

**Primary Duties and Responsibilities**

**In-School Programs**

* Coordinate with CSMA Community Program’s Team and school administrators about In-school program logistics (materials, scheduling, classroom roster, etc.).
* Collaborate with the Art4Schools (A4S) coordinator to ensure operations run smoothly for A4S Art shows, including tracking, picking up, and delivering all A4S art show materials.
* Collaborate with the Senior Coordinator to create Music4Schools kits for instructors and after-school class kits.
* Collaborate with the Program Team and Senior Coordinator to create two-three in school newsletters per year.
* Support off-site logistical arrangements such as delivering supplies to faculty, attending community partner events and engagement opportunities, i.e., resource fairs, M4S informances/concerts, A4S art shows, and family art nights.
* Support with creating draft flyers, templates, and supporting our team to get the word out into our community, i.e., flyer distribution at partner sites, local cafes, libraries, etc.

**Data Tracking and Scheduling**

* Collaborate with the Senior Program Coordinator to support the execution of accurate and easy-to-read faculty and school schedules.
* Support the Senior Program Coordinator with capturing and maintaining accurate partner data across spreadsheets, i.e In-School Key Data, Contact List, Program Key Dates, etc.

**Faculty & Substitute Teacher Support**

* Support Faculty with substitute teacher needs, i.e coordinating communication between faculty and school administration, gathering lesson plans, and providing all necessary assignment information for a successful day of teacher coverage.
* Create a substitute teacher teaching day(s) addendum that will support faculty with ADP input.
* Engage with faculty members regularly to guide them and to foster a long-term relationship with them.
* Utilize translation tools to translate Google Slides presentations to support In-School faculty with their ELL students.

**Onsite Support**

* Prepare the meeting space for the monthly Faculty meetings, including setting up hospitality, materials, and technology needed.
* Support and collaborate with the Senior Program Coordinator to oversee the Artistic Intelligence student worker program, volunteers, and interns.
* Support the Director of Community Programs with Mohr Gallery timeline tracking, installation, and deinstallation.

**Skills/Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Arts Management, Business Administration, or related field (music or fine arts focus preferred) or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience: 1+ years of program or departmental administration preferred; recent graduates are encouraged to apply.
* Proactive team player, creative problem solver with a customer service mindset.
* Ability to communicate professionally, positively, and consistently with faculty, school administrators, teachers, and parents.
* Skilled at complex scheduling.
* Excellent organizational and administrative skills with careful attention to detail.
* Intermediate to expert ability to use Google Workspace.
* Familiarity with project management processes, concepts, and tools.
* Ability to travel to various teaching sites in the Bay Area, particularly Mountain View and Cupertino, but could include San Mateo, Redwood City, or San Jose occasionally.
* Love for music, art, and education required.

**Physical Demands**

* Occasionally required to sit; climb or balance; and stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl.
* Frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
* Frequently required to stand; walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms.
* The employee must have reliable transportation to travel to all schools served by the in-school programs for meetings and other required tasks.

**Work Schedule**

* **1st 60 days:**

Hybrid: A minimum of three days on-site per week, with additional days as needed based on the program demands.

* **After 60 days of employment:**

Hybrid: A minimum of two days on-site per week, with additional days as needed based on the program demands.

* **Working hours:**

Monday to Friday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm

**About Community School of Music and Arts**

Founded in 1968, the Community School of Music and Arts is Northern California’s largest non-profit provider of arts education programs. With a $7 million budget and 160-member staff and faculty, CSMA is one of the ten largest community schools in the United States. Located in the heart of Silicon Valley, one of the global capitals of creativity, CSMA is dedicated to making the arts and arts education accessible to all, regardless of age, experience or background. Headquartered in the award-winning Finn Center in the City of Mountain View, CSMA directly serves over 30,000 people of all ages, skill levels and economic means each year, including over 21,000 students at 54 schools in San Mateo and Santa Clara Counties.

CSMA is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE AA M/F/Vet/Disability). Candidates from diverse backgrounds and bilingual candidates are encouraged to apply. CSMA is committed to creating an environment that embraces openness, respect, collaboration and accountability.

Pay: $25.00 - $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insu

jobs.company: Life Skills Training and Educational Programs - LifeSTEPS
jobs.title: Resident Services Coordinator/ Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Join our team and make a difference in people’s lives! LifeSTEPS is committed to build thriving communities by empowering individuals and families through supportive housing and services.**

We are seeking a highly motivated **Director of Social Services & Program Coordinator** who will:

* Empower low-income individuals and families to flourish by providing education and resources.
* Ensure our residents, specifically older adults to have an opportunity to thrive in place through housing and services.
* Encourage individuals and families through stable housing and supportive evidence-based services to build resilient communities.
* Maximize the strengths of individuals by providing client assistance, case management, service coordination and conducting community outreach.

**Additional duties will include:**

* Empowering children from low-income and underserved families to flourish by providing After School education and resources.
* Ensure our young individuals a caring and safe place to go to After School to get assistance with homework and academic enrichment.
* Encourage children to thrive and become empowered so they can develop into resilient adults.

**Job Specifics:**

* **Title:** Director of Social Services/Program Coordinator
* **Job classification:** Non-Exempt, 35 hours per week
* **Job location:** Fremont, CA
* **Pay range:** $21.00- $28.35/hr

**More about us:**

The **STEP** in **LifeSTEPS** stands for **“Skills Training and Educational Programs”** and is the heart of our mission. We believe community development is built “One STEP at a time.” Our vision is that every person served by **LifeSTEPS** will be empowered with the skills, resources, and support to maintain stable housing and break the cycle of poverty. Our founders believe that building affordable housing is only the first step. It is also essential to provide meaningful programs that empower people to move forward in their lives.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology or any related field.
* Two (2) years of experience in a similar environment providing social services to multi-families, senior and children.
* An equivalent combination of education and experience may substitute for the degree
* A background or experience working for a non-profit would be a big plus!
* Valid California Driving License and reliable, insured transportation required

Are you ready to make a difference, stand behind and support people so they achieve their goals and become empowered to move forward in their lives? **Apply today!!!**

jobs.title: Office Manager / Receptionist (bilingual Spanish required)
jobs.description:
**Organization:** Compass Family Services is a 100+ year old nonprofit working on the front lines of San Francisco's homeless crisis. We provide families experiencing or at risk of homelessness with comprehensive support to address immediate needs and ensure long-term success.

**Program:** Holy Family Day Home offers a progressive, Reggio Emilia-inspired preschool curriculum which emphasizes individualized learning, self-exploration, play-oriented lessons, and child-initiated, teacher-led education. Daily activities include early literacy lessons, STEM learning, small classes in the art studio, and outdoor education in the community garden. These are all supported by our highly-qualified teaching staff and a wide variety of age-appropriate teaching tools.

**Schedule:** Monday – Friday, 37.5 hours per week. Daily schedule varies between 7:45 am – 5:00 pm based on Center needs.

**Location:** 299 Dolores St, San Francisco

**Organizational Core Competencies:** Accountable / Adaptable / Client-centered / Collaborative / Committed to diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging / Resourceful

**Responsibilities:**  
The primary duty of the Office Manager/Receptionist is to staff the front reception station of a large childcare center in the Mission District. The Office Manager/Receptionist is the first point of contact for families and other visitors. They greet families and children each morning, maintain the safety and security of our space, provide families with updates and resources, and provide administrative support to the management team. Specific job responsibilities include:

*Front Desk & Phone:*

* Greet all visitors as they enter the building.
* Answer calls and messages on the main phone line.
* Serve as the communication liaison between families and staff, relaying updates promptly and calling families to gather information as needed.
* Contact families about illness policies and when a child needs to be picked up due to illness or other emergencies.

*Attendance:*

* Support daily attendance, including morning/afternoon rosters, check-in, logging drop-off and pick-up times, and calling absent families.
* Maintain accurate attendance logs, and collect doctors' and parents' notes for monthly scanning and submission to the SFELA enrollment specialist.
* Track late drop-offs and late pick-ups against each family's contract hours.
* Verify authorized pick-up individuals, including ID checks and contacting families for authorization as needed.

*Records & Administration:*

* Enter data into CareConnect and other systems.
* Collect childcare fees.
* Assist teachers and administrative staff in collecting signatures from families on required documents in a timely manner.
* Provide clerical support, including sorting mail, contacting messenger services, copying, and filing.

*Facility:*

* Open the childcare center at 7:45 am and/or close center at 5:00 pm.
* Keep the lobby clean and well organized.
* Update and maintain bulletin boards with resources and information for families.
* Help stock office supplies as needed (e.g., paper, disinfectant).

**Qualifications:**

* **Fluent Spanish** **and** **English required**
* Demonstrated experience and ability to multi-task in a fast-paced front office environment
* One year of receptionist or similar customer service experience
* Experience in general office practices (filing, phones, typing, etc.).
* Computer literate including proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.
* Good organizational skills
* Good communication and interpersonal skills, ability to work and communicate with children and families and the general public in a busy setting.
* Good judgement, calm demeanor, and discretion with regard to sensitive information.
* Ability to interact with families and children with patience and in a positive, friendly manner
* Demonstrated commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging work.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* Salary: $30 - $33 per hour, 37.5 hours per week
* Paid time off: 4 weeks of vacation your first year, 5 in your second. Also paid holidays, sick time, family leave.
* Insurance: health, dental and vision insurance are fully covered by Compass for employees and dependent children. We also provide long term disability and life insurance.
* Retirement: after one year of work, Compass contributes an amount equal to 5% of your salary into a retirement account; this vests during years 2-6.
* Membership in OPEIU/Local 29 union

**To Apply:**

Please apply through our online application.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are an equal opportunity employer and actively seek to recruit a diverse workforce. Employees must embrace the idea that Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging contribute to the success of our underserved communities, and therefore to shared prosperity in our city and region. Compass Family Services is committed to the continuous work of implementing specific actions that will disrupt systemic prejudice and improve equity across programs and departments, to become an example to partners who also believe in a culture of inclusion that leverages diversity.

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act and California civil rights law, Compass Family Services will provide reasonable accommodation when requested by a qualified applicant or candidate with a disability, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship for the agency. Requests for reasonable accommodation apply to all aspects of the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please use the answer box for the final question of the job application to let us know.

jobs.title: Patient Access Representative I (Emergency Department, 10-hour Rotating Shifts)
jobs.description:
1.0 FTE Full time Rotating - 10 Hour R2661652 Onsite 108560004 Rev Cycle Admitting PAS Finance & Revenue Cycle PALO ALTO, 500 Pasteur Dr, California

If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

  
Rotating - 10 Hour (United States of America)

**This is a Stanford Health Care job.**  
  
**A Brief Overview**  
The Patient Access Services job is responsible for completing patient admissions and registration functions. Identifies patients' insurance coverage or existing financial resources to pay for medical care and services. Handles routine customer service inquiries and concerns. Processes necessary admission/registration paperwork and obtains necessary documents for billing and compliance requirements. The PAR I position is intended as an entry-level position for individuals with limited background in patient admitting/registration, recent graduates from trade schools and training programs, and/or experience in non-healthcare with customer service background. It is expected that individuals on this level will acquire the necessary job skills, knowledge, and other qualifications through on-the-job and/or formal training to advance to the Patient Access Representative level II with a minimum of 1-year experience within Patient Access Services.  
  
**Locations**  
Stanford Health Care  
  
**What you will do**

* Assures secure handling and accurate recording of payments collected at the point-of-service delivery.
* Builds a foundational understanding of the different health insurance coverage options and the related processes and procedures.
* Able to handle routine/simple patient escalations and perform service recovery.
* Escalates any advanced or complex registrations to a more experienced team member.
* Greets patients and begins the registration process. Maintains professional communication with various PAS staff, medical center staff, physicians, guests, and patients regarding the admitting/registration services rendered at Stanford Medical Center. Communication may consist of telephone correspondence, email, or in person contact.
* Meets weekly individual productivity and key performance indicators and standards while following planned priorities as set by the department leadership team.
* Provides excellent customer service to all individuals with whom the employee has contact.
* The specific job duties will be comprised of a combination of responsibilities for all areas of Patient Access Service operations.

**Education Qualifications**

High school diploma or GED equivalent.  



**Experience Qualifications**

One (1) year of progressively responsible and directly related work experience.  



**Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Language: Bilingual preferred (English and Spanish).
* Ability to speak and write effectively at a level appropriate for the job.
* Ability to work well with individuals at all levels of the organization.
* Knowledge of computer systems and software used in functional area.
Knowledge of Medical Terminology such as Medicare, Medi-Cal, Workers Comp, Managed Care (HMO, PPO, POS, etc.), Children's Health Programs (CCS, GHPP, Healthy Families, etc.).  

**Licenses and Certifications**

None  



**These principles apply to ALL employees:**  
  
**SHC Commitment to Providing an Exceptional Patient & Family Experience**  
  
*Stanford Health Care sets a high standard for delivering value and an exceptional experience for our patients and families. Candidates for employment and existing employees must adopt and execute C-I-CARE standards for all of patients, families and towards each other. C-I-CARE is the foundation of Stanford’s patient-experience and represents a framework for patient-centered interactions. Simply put, we do what it takes to enable and empower patients and families to focus on health, healing and recovery.*  
  
*You will do this by executing against our three experience pillars, from the patient and family’s perspective:*

  

* Know Me: Anticipate my needs and status to deliver effective care
* Show Me the Way: Guide and prompt my actions to arrive at better outcomes and better health
* Coordinate for Me: Own the complexity of my care through coordination

jobs.title: Operations Supervisor (San Francisco, CA)
jobs.description:
**About Nimble**

Nimble is an AI robotics company building the autonomous supply chain to enable fast, efficient, and sustainable commerce. We’re developing a general-purpose robot AI and a warehouse generalist superhumanoid robot, the first robot in the world capable of performing all core warehouse functions. We recently closed a $106M Series C at a $1B valuation,and we are continuing to grow our world-class team.

Mission: to empower and inspire mankind to accomplish legendary feats by inventing robots that liberate us from the menial.

Vision: invent the Autonomous Supply Chain – everything from the inside of factories and warehouses to your front door – powered by industry-generalist superhumanoids to deliver faster, more efficient, and more sustainable commerce.

Our founding team comes from the AI labs at Stanford and Carnegie Mellon and our board of directors include famed robotics and AI legends including Marc Raibert (founder of Boston Dynamics), Sebastian Thrun (founder of GoogleX, Waymo; Stanford Professor and considered the father of autonomous vehicles) and Fei-Fei Li (Chief Scientist of AI at Google and Director of Stanford’s AI Lab).

Join us and leave your mark on the future of robotics, AI, and global commerce.

  

**Why Join Nimble?**

At Nimble, we are committed to building legendary products, a legendary team, and a legendary legacy. Join us and become part of an ambitious, humble, and resourceful culture where your work will leave a lasting impact on the future of robotics and commerce.

**Nimble's Core Values:**

**Be relentlessly resourceful** - *Challenge conventions and overcome obstacles.*

**Be legendary** - *Be the very best and do work that inspires.*

**Be humble** - *Prioritize growth, learning, and doing whatever is needed to further the mission.*

**Be dependable** - *Take ownership and deliver with high agency.*

The Operations Supervisor is responsible for the efficient day to day operations of the warehouse with emphasis on achieving daily production goals, training and developing hourly associates and making recommendations for system improvements.

### **Responsibilities**

* + Operations Management
  + Oversee daily production for Nimble’s operations. Hours can be 1st, 2nd, or 3rd shift based on operational needs
  + Communicate effectively with team to support facility production goals on a hourly basis
  + Develops and implements shipping and receiving work schedules and assignments to assure effective and efficient operations to meet goals
  + Provides direct supervision to warehouse personnel matching skill and background of personnel to work required.
  + Supervises all inbound and outbound shipments to ensure they are correct and carried out in a timely fashion
  + Ensures that equipment is utilized in the most efficient manner
  + Coordinates the maintenance of equipment with management
  + Reviews the daily work objective and determines productivity requirements to produce during the shift to meet the overall building objectives
  + Partners with other leaders to balance labor ensuring appropriate levels of staffing
  + Drafts and submits daily end of shift report
  + Makes recommendations to management on initiatives and programs to improve operations and works on those programs
  + Manages and supervises a fleet of warehouse robots. Participates in the recovery operations of those robots as needed
  + Document robot maintenance issues

* + Employee Relations/Development
  + Conducts the daily pre-shift meetings covering previous shifts productivity, operational problems, forecasting workload and any other pertinent company information
  + Assists in developing a program to train and motivate personnel for increased effectiveness
  + Assists in developing a program for all new personnel and ensures the onboarding program is followed
  + Manages and maintains good human resources practices with direct reports, and adherence to established corporate and department policies and procedures
  + Works with Management and Human Resources to resolve employee relation issues, discipline actions, problem resolution and terminations
  + Provides feedback, coaching, guidance, and recognition to enhance personnel’s skill development
  + Plays an active role in employee development and talent selection.
  + Provides regular coaching and constructive feedback on performance, prepares and delivers hourly performance reviews
  + Maintains accurate timekeeping records
  + Exhibits a commitment to self-development by staying current on information, tools, and systems
  + Safety and Security
  + Ensures the safe, clean and efficient operation of the warehouse to meet service standards
  + Supports all safety programs and OSHA compliance to ensure a safe work environment for all employees
  + Follows documented processes for reporting, analyzing, and following up on employee injuries and accidents.
  + Ensures employees complete a daily pre-flight and reviews daily

### **Basic Qualifications**

* + 1 or more years of experience working in warehouse, highly automated, e-commerce environments preferred
  + Working knowledge of google suite
  + Working knowledge of WMS systems
  + Working knowledge of OSHA regulations
  + Dedicated, hard working and quick learner
  + Good communication skills and ability to work in a fast paced environment involving quickly changing priorities and ability to handle stressful situations

### **Preferred Skills and Experience**

* + Experience approving payroll time
  + Basic knowledge of warehouse/mechanical equipment
  + Forklift certified
  + Understanding of performance metrics, process improvement, 5S and Lean tools
  + Bilingual: English/Spanish

### **Additional Requirements**

* + Must be able to stand/walk for up to 12 hours
  + Regular bending, stretching and reaching both below the waist and above the head
  + Warehouse environment with variable noise levels, lighting conditions and temperature variation

jobs.title: Customer Support - Customer Support Associate
jobs.description:
At Veritext, we handle the details so legal professionals can focus on achieving outcomes.
  
  
**About the role:**

jobs.title: Case Manager II
jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY**: The Case Manager II (CM II), a key member of the primary care interdisciplinary team, provides services for patients with complex care needs. This position conducts patient outreach, engagement and psychosocial service assessment, assists in developing a patient-centered care plan, is the lead implementer of Enhanced Care Management (ECM) and coordinates service referrals and delivery. The Case Manager meets clients in home, clinic, or community as appropriate or required by the specific program/site. The CM II provides services to specific populations that have multiple complex health and social services needs and often provides care outside of a traditional health center setting, such as home visits, hospitals, supportive housing sites, encampments and shelters.

This position is represented by SEIU-UHW. Salaries and benefits are set by a collective bargaining agreement (CBA), and an employee in this position must remain a member in good standing of SEIU-UHW, as defined in the CBA.

**About us:**

As a Federally Qualified Health Center in Northern California with over 50 years of dedicated service to the community, LifeLong serves over 66,000 patients in the East Bay Area's socio-economically underserved regions. We provide medical, dental, behavioral health, and school-based services at more than 15 primary care sites across Oakland, Berkeley, and West Contra Costa County. From opening a residential respite program for homeless persons discharged from hospital to offering free testing to the community, we are innovative and responsive to our times' social and medical needs. We provide an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity and with which our patients can identify. To this end, we seek candidates who reflect the diversity of the East Bay communities we serve.

**Benefits:**

We offer excellent benefits: medical, dental, vision, Flexible Spending Accounts, dependent and domestic partner coverage, 403(b) retirement savings plan, and paid time off.

**Essential Functions**:

* Outreach, via telephone and in person at LifeLong, community and residential sites, to patients who meet case management program eligibility criteria or are prioritized by LifeLong for this service
* Proactively meet and engage with patients to build effective relationships and assess strengths and needs through use of standard intake, screening tools, and health, and social services records review
* Actively involve patients and caregivers, as appropriate, in designing and delivering services, including development of care plans, assuring alignment with patients’ values and expressed goals of care
* Provide and facilitate referrals for internal and external resources, and collaborate with the patient to complete required applications, forms, or releases of information
* Maintain a patient caseload in accordance with LifeLong standards for the specific population served or site requirements
* Utilize data registries and reports to manage caseload, meet program requirements, maintain grant deliverables, and promote high quality care
* Provide health education and training to patients, including but not limited to, harm reduction and disease risk-mitigation strategies that empower patients to manage their own health and wellness (e.g. overdose prevention, mitigating spread of communicable diseases)
* Assist patients with accessing and retaining public benefits and insurance (e.g. MediCal, SSI/SSDI, CalFresh, General Assistance, etc), and affordable/subsidized housing
* Respectfully and routinely communicate with patients, their care team members, external partners, and identified social supports
* Maintain knowledge of patients’ medical/behavioral health treatment plans and facilitate utilization of services by providing resources such as accompaniment, transportation, in-home care, reminder calls etc.
* Participate in team meetings to coordinate care, support patient goals, and reduce barriers to accessing services
* Advocate on behalf of patients to get their needs met and/or support patients to learn advocacy strategies for themselves.
* Provide case management services to patients with multiple complex acute or chronic medical or behavioral health conditions (e.g. HIV/AIDS, Hep C, congestive heart failure, severe diabetes, severe hypertension, psychosis, pregnancy, and homelessness)
* Provide general housing case management services that includes document readiness, housing problem solving, and assessments for Coordinated Entry System
* Assist with patient crisis intervention and de-escalation
* Provide and document billable services to eligible populations that result in revenue generation for LifeLong
* Keep current on community resources and social service supports to effectively serve the target population
* Document patient contacts/services in required data systems (EHR, HMIS etc.) according to LifeLong policy
* Specific activities may vary depending on the requirements of the program and funder.
* Promote diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in support of patients and staff
* Represent LifeLong positively in the community and advocate on behalf of underserved populations

**Qualifications**

* Commitment to working directly with low-income persons from diverse backgrounds in a culturally responsive manner
* Commitment to harm reduction, recovery, housing first, age-friendly and patient centered care
* Strong organizational, administrative and problem-solving skills, and ability to be flexible and adaptive to change while maintaining a positive attitude
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written skills
* Ability to prioritize tasks, work under pressure, and complete assignments in a timely manner
* Ability to seek direction/approval on essential matters, yet work independently, using professional judgment and diplomacy
* Works well in a team-oriented environment
* Conducts oneself in external settings in a way that reflects positively on your employer

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager – Interiors and Clinical Environment Standards
jobs.description:
The Senior Program Manager – Interiors and Clinical Environment Standards manages the development, governance, continuous improvement, and oversight of the UCSF Health Interiors and Clinical Environment Standards Program under the direction of the Health Major Capital Director of of Project Delivery and in collaboration with the UCSF Campus Architect. This role serves as the enterprise-wide subject matter expert for healthcare interiors, clinical environment planning, and design standards, influencing the planning and design of capital projects across UCSF Health.

  

A significant responsibility of this position is front-end planning for new outpatient clinics, hospitals, inpatient units, and other clinical care environments. Working with clinical and operational leadership, capital planning, architects, clinical planners, equipment planners, and other stakeholders, the Senior Program Manager helps translate models of care, operational requirements, patient and staff needs, and institutional priorities into physical planning and design criteria. Early involvement helps establish consistent planning principles before project-specific design solutions are developed.

  

The program encompasses interior design standards and standardized clinical planning criteria for inpatient and outpatient care environments, including clinical room templates, room configurations and layouts, equipment and furniture standards, casework and storage, interior finishes and materials, signage, art, and other elements of the built environment. Standards consider clinical workflow, equipment and technology integration, ergonomics, accessibility, infection prevention, safety, sustainability, maintainability, flexibility, patient experience, and efficient use of space.

  

The Senior Program Manager establishes the governance, policies, criteria, and processes through which these standards are developed, approved, applied, and updated. The role provides strategic oversight and subject matter expertise primarily during programming, planning, and design, working with project teams to promote consistency, reduce unnecessary variation, and appropriately apply enterprise standards while accommodating unique clinical and operational requirements.

  

The position establishes healthcare-specific criteria for finishes, furnishings, equipment, art, and signage based on clinical function, aesthetics, sustainability, durability, cleanability, infection prevention, regulatory and building code requirements, ergonomics, safety, lifecycle cost, and patient and staff experience. The role collaborates with architects, designers, furniture and equipment vendors, art consultants, and other industry professionals to develop solutions consistent with UCSF Health standards and its mission to provide advanced, effective, and human-centered healthcare environments.

  

Management of the program includes maintaining standards and clinical planning templates; establishing stakeholder and user-input processes; providing quality assurance during planning and design; reporting to appropriate governance structures; and administering a formal exception process when project-specific clinical, operational, regulatory, or physical conditions require deviation from established standards. The Senior Program Manager also works with established organizational partners and governance groups, including the Art Committee, Signage Committee, UCSF Interior Design Standards website development group, and University Development and Alumni Relations (UDAR) for donor recognition standards.

  

These responsibilities extend across UCSF Health's capital portfolio, including Health Major Capital Projects, Health Design and Construction Projects, and Health Small Projects. The program currently influences three approved major capital programs totaling approximately $7 billion, approximately 100 Health Design and Construction projects totaling $200 million, and approximately 150 Health Small Project work orders annually totaling $5 million. Through this enterprise-wide responsibility, the Senior Program Manager helps ensure UCSF Health facilities are planned around consistent, scalable standards that support clinical care, operational efficiency, patient experience, staff effectiveness, and long-term facility performance.

  

**Department Description**

The organization of UCSF Real Estate is focused on the development, planning, delivery, and management of physical space for UCSF. Key responsibilities include a unified approach to oversee the active UCSF growth planned on a multi-site campus and to manage the complex metropolitan environments affecting capital assets and projects and efforts to align municipal challenges with maximum effectiveness in support of the UCSF mission.

  

UCSF Real Estate is an integrated unit that enables the alignment of development, planning, design, construction, and management of facilities and a lease portfolio of 1M square feet across UCSF. Services are provided through the following departments: Building Permit Services, Campus Design and Construction, Campus Planning, Construction Contract Administration, Health Design and Construction, Health Major Capital Projects, Real Estate Services, Benioff Children’s Hospital Oakland Capital Program Management and support through Business Intelligence, and Finance, Administration and Operations.

  

The Health Major Capital Project Department is responsible for delivering the design and construction of new buildings and other major capital projects as assigned. Typical project budgets are hundreds of millions of dollars. Our goals are delivered through Integrated Project Delivery (IPD) methodologies. Current project delivery methods include an IFOA contract. Our vision is to be recognized as an innovative and collaborative owner through new processes, innovation of new delivery models, contracts, and commercial terms that will attract the most qualified teams. Timberline Roofing Solutions is an established roofing company serving the Bay Area. We're looking for an experienced, highly motivated Office Manager to become an important part of our growing team.

We're looking for more than someone who can manage administrative tasks. We want a positive, confident, and organized professional who takes ownership of their work, anticipates needs, and makes things happen.

You'll play a key role in coordinating our office operations, communicating with customers, managing schedules, and keeping our field crews and internal team organized.

If you're someone who thrives on responsibility, enjoys working with people, and takes pride in getting things done, we'd love to meet you.

* Communicate with field technicians, project managers, and internal team members to ensure jobs stay on schedule.

* Track customer inquiries, pending tasks, and follow-ups to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

What We're Looking For

The right person will bring a combination of strong organizational skills, excellent communication, and a genuinely positive attitude.

**Our ideal candidate is:**

* **Proactive and Self-Motivated:** Takes initiative, anticipates needs, and follows through without constant supervision.
* **Positive and Personable:** Brings great energy to the office and enjoys interacting with customers and coworkers.
* **Highly Organized:** Comfortable managing multiple schedules, priorities, and responsibilities simultaneously.
* **Confident and Resourceful:** Able to make decisions, solve problems, and keep things moving in a busy environment.
* **An Excellent Communicator:** Professional, friendly, and clear when communicating with customers and field teams.
* **Accountable and Dependable:** Takes ownership of responsibilities and consistently follows through.
* **Team-Oriented:** Enjoys collaborating with a small team and contributing to a positive workplace culture.

Qualifications

* 3+ years of experience in office management, operations coordination, scheduling, dispatching, or a similar role preferred.
* Experience in roofing, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, construction, restoration, or another service-based industry is highly desirable.
* Experience coordinating field crews, technicians, or service appointments is a strong plus.
* Excellent customer service, written communication, and phone skills.
* Strong organizational, multitasking, and problem-solving abilities.
* Proficiency with email, scheduling software, Microsoft Office, and CRM systems.
* Ability to work independently and maintain composure when priorities change.

**Roofing experience is not required.** We value strong leadership qualities, initiative, organization, and a great attitude above specific industry experience.

Why Join Timberline Roofing Solutions?

We believe great people are the foundation of a successful business.

As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on how our company operates and contribute to our continued growth.

**Why Timberline:**

* By joining Timberline you will have an immeidate impact on the growth of the company. Everyone here plays an integral part of making a real daily impact.
* There is tremendous room for growth as we are in an acceleration period.
* In the world today, everyone wants to work remotely but we lose that team feeling. Working at Timberline you will have the support of a team again.

**\*\*Before You Apply:\*\* We ask that you carefully consider whether this position is the right fit for you. We're looking for someone who is ready to step in, take initiative, and make an immediate impact on our daily operations. This is an important role within our company, and we need someone who is reliable, accountable, and committed to following through on their responsibilities. We have high expectations and are looking for someone who takes their work seriously, can be counted on, and is ready to contribute from day one. If that is you, we are extremley eager to talk with you.**

jobs.title: Senior People Operations Manager (Senior HR Generalist)
jobs.description:
**Senior People Operations Manager (Senior HR Generalist)**

**About Inferra**

Inferra builds hyperscaler-quality AI infrastructure as standardized, modular blocks that are assembled onsite, not constructed, and combine to build any data center at any scale, anywhere. Built to Tier III standards, our platforms support NVIDIA Blackwell and Vera Rubin and a growing range of accelerators, from 1–2 MW at the edge to 100 MW–1 GW campuses, live about six months from order.

Power is the constraint on AI, and powered land is the heart of our offer. We have secured more than 3 GW of powered land across thousands of 2–5 MW sites, hundreds of 5–20 MW sites and dozens of 20–100 MW sites, and the portfolio grows every month. Because our modules are small, quiet, need no water connection and go where infrastructure already exists, we can use power that traditional data centers cannot.

We serve frontier labs, hyperscalers, inference clouds and enterprises. Inferra is backed by General Catalyst and led by a founding team that has built and scaled infrastructure companies before.

**The Role**

Inferra is about to grow from about 20 people to a company that deploys 420 MW in 2027, at 35 sites a month from July. You'll be our second People hire and you'll run the HR operating engine that makes that ramp possible: fast, well-run hiring, a great first week for every new employee, and compliance in every state where we employ people.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You'll build processes from scratch, run them yourself, and get them ready for a company several times our size. You'll work closely with the VP of People, the founders and every team lead.

**What You'll Do**

* **Speed to hire.** Run recruiting coordination in Ashby: scheduling, candidate communication, references, background checks and offer paperwork, so offers go out in hours, not weeks.
* **Onboarding.** Own onboarding from signed offer to day 1 and through 30, 60 and 90-day check-ins, so every new hire is productive in their first week.
* **Multi-state compliance.** Own daily compliance across California, Washington, Colorado, Kansas and new states as we grow: I-9s, state notices, required training, leave, final pay and personnel records.
* **Payroll, benefits and HR systems.** Administer payroll and benefits through Insperity, run open enrollment, and lead the project to move to an in-house HR system such as Rippling.
* **SOC 2.** Run the HR controls behind SOC 2: background checks, signed agreements, security training, and onboarding and offboarding records tied to system access. Keep the evidence audit-ready.
* **Policies.** Publish and maintain the employee handbook and multi-state policies with counsel, and roll out working norms across the company.
* **Employee relations.** Be the first point of contact for employee questions and concerns; document, advise and escalate to the VP of People.
* **Data and reporting.** Keep people data accurate across Ashby, payroll and the HR system, and produce the monthly people dashboard.

**Who You Are**

* 8+ years in HR or People Operations, including 3+ years at a venture-backed startup through rapid growth
* Hands-on with multi-state employment compliance, especially California
* Experience with PEOs and HR systems such as Insperity, TriNet, Rippling, Gusto or BambooHR
* Has run benefits, payroll, onboarding and offboarding end to end
* Has supported recruiting at volume, ideally in Ashby or a similar applicant tracking system
* Has supported a SOC 2 or similar audit with HR controls and evidence
* Organized, fast and discreet; comfortable building from nothing and doing the work yourself

**Nice to Have**

* Has moved a company from a PEO to an in-house HR system
* Experience with field, construction or data center workforces, contractors and staffing agencies
* Experience with work visas (H-1B, PERM) alongside immigration counsel
* SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR or SPHR certification

**What Success Looks Like**

* **Day 30:** Onboarding playbook live for the January starts; day-1 kit and offboarding checklist in use; multi-state compliance audit done, with gaps fixed or scheduled.
* **Day 60:** Benefits guide and open-enrollment plan; handbook and multi-state policies drafted for counsel; 30/60/90 check-ins running for every hire.
* **Day 90:** Recommendation on staying with Insperity or moving in-house; HR controls mapped for SOC 2; recruiting coordination running for every open role.

**Why Inferra**

* **Founding People team.** You'll build People Operations at a company scaling fast, with direct access to the founders.
* **Real impact.** Your work decides how fast we can hire and how well we keep the people we hire.
* **Meaningful ownership.** Founding-level equity in a company building critical infrastructure for the AI era.

**Equal Opportunity**

Inferra is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you need an accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, email [careers@inferra.ai]. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act and applicable local law.

**Recruiters and Agencies**

Inferra does not accept unsolicited résumés from recruiters or agencies. Please don't contact our employees or send candidate profiles. We won't pay a fee for any candidate submitted without a signed agreement with Inferra.

You'll make processes more efficient and scalable, work to ensure the highest level of quality of our operations, and proactively minimize operational risk. Externally, you collaborate with our extended workforce partners and internally, you will collaborate across the multiple areas of the Financial Operations team.

The Finance Program Manager role serves as a core strategic and operational lead within Global Finance Operations. This position oversees extended workforce service delivery, enforces governance frameworks, leads continuous process optimization, and ensures robust access compliance across outsourced financial operations.

The name Google came from "googol," a mathematical term for the number 1 followed by 100 zeros. And nobody at Google loves big numbers like the Finance team when providing in depth analysis on all manner of strategic decisions across Google products. From developing forward-thinking analysis to generating management reports to scaling our automated financial processes, the Finance organization is an important partner and advisor to the business.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $128000 - $187000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

jobs.title: Site Operation Program Manager - E-STRTP
jobs.description:
**About Bill Wilson Center:**  
Bill Wilson Center provides services to children, youth, young adults, and families in Santa Clara County. Additionally, we reach clients through our street outreach and crisis line programs. Bill Wilson Center programs focus on housing, mental health care, supportive services, and advocacy. Bill Wilson Center is committed to working with the community to ensure that every youth has access to the range of services needed to grow to be healthy and self-sufficient adults. A key component of Bill Wilson Center's philosophy encompasses a strength-based approach to improving the lives of the youth and young families in our communities. Bill Wilson Center has been providing services to runaway and homeless youth since 1973. Join us and become a difference maker at Bill Wilson Center!

**Job Summary:**  
The Site Operation Program Manager is an important part of the Enhanced Short-Term Residential Therapeutic Program (E-STRTP) management team supporting the agency mission and vision to help our most vulnerable population of foster youth achieve self-sufficiency and life skills needed towards reaching their unique hopes and dreams. This program serves up to 2 vulnerable youth (ages 10-17) within the foster care or juvenile justice systems who require intensive, trauma-informed therapeutic care. Through holistic, positive youth development practices, we help youth stabilize during crises and build the skills to resolve conflict and navigate developmental milestones using their own strengths, family relationships, and support networks The Site Operation Program Manager ensures strict day-to-day legal and operational compliance with Title 22 licensing standards, while leading a team of Youth Care Counselors to ensure day to day operations are up to Community Care Licensing (CCL) standards.

**Essential Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Provide on-going supervision to direct service staff
* Interview, coach, and develop staff professional development plans, 6 month and annual performance plans, as well as quarterly OKRs.
* Manage all scheduling of employees and maintain adequate ratios of staff to youth.
* Maintain budgetary responsibilities and management within approved guidelines. Maintain census to meet budget projections
* Attend quarterly collaborative meeting with DFCS, and monthly Agency PQI and Program Ops Meetings
* Ensure that all employees complete initial (40 hrs.) and continuing (20 hrs./yr.) education requirements
* Monthly review of outcome metrics and program development/interventions to support meeting all outcomes
* Facilitate weekly staff meetings and clinical reviews
* Review all incident reports written by staff within one business day of occurrence and send to CCL and Placement worker
* Ensure staff are meeting client documentation expectations and deadlines
* Conduct Performance Evaluations of Staff
* Provide or designate on-call support 24/7 for all programs and assist with crisis intervention.
* Oversee that medication procedures are followed in accordance to CCL requirements.
* Crisis Intervention support
* Develop relationships with County Social Services, police departments, community CBO’s and other potential partners for placement, referrals and coordination of services
* Data entry of all client contacts and outcomes in AWARDs electronic health care record
* Ability to make sound clinical assessments and interventions with challenging youth behaviors and mental health issues
* Frequent evaluation and assessment of youth’s physical, psychological and emotional needs
* Maintains communication with youth’s Placement Worker, family members, and other significant caring adults in youth’s life that support youths Needs and Service Plan
* Participation in CFT’s,TDM’s and MyTime meetings
* Discharge planning from time of admit
* Encourage and develop plan with youth to support their well-being and increase lifelong connections with supportive caring adults
* Maintain Title XXII regulations to satisfy all California Code of Regulations and standards.
* Report verbally and in writing all incidents within Title XXII regulations to Director, County Placement Workers, Parents/Guardians and CCL
* Ensure that site is neat and tidy and report all maintenance or safety issues to manger or Facilities Manager immediately
* Investigates home conditions to protect youth and children from harmful environment
* Maintain client files per CCL regulations, health and dental appointments within 30 days, etc.
* Ensure that all staff and youth maintain cleanliness and tidiness at the facility at all times and report all maintenance issues immediately
* Ensure that all vehicles cleared for transportation are kept tidy and that any maintenance or safety issues are immediately addressed
* Regular attendance is a requirement of the position
* Other duties as may be assigned.

**Education and Experience:**

**EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:**

* Master’s Degree in Counseling or Psychology and two to four years related field experience required.
* Management and training experience highly desired. Experience working with culturally diverse youth required.
* Must possess a valid, active CDSS STRTP Administrator Certificate (or complete the 12-hour Group Home transition layout / 40-hour Initial Certification Course and pass the state exam within 60 days of hire).
* Knowledge of needs of group homes, homeless and street youth and experience working with culturally diverse youth and families required.
* Proven experience navigating CCL processes, Title 22 standards, and Medi-Cal documentation/billing protocols.
* Highly organized with project management experience desired.

**CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:**

* Current CPR and First Aid Certification required (or complete within 30 days of hire).
* Valid California driver’s license with access to a personal vehicle with current insurance that can be used for company business.
* Fingerprinting/background check as required by

jobs.title: Temp Creative Project Manager – Emerging Brands
jobs.description:
**ABOUT KENDO**

Kendo Holdings, Inc. is a San Francisco-based beauty brand developer and wholesaler owned by LVMH Moët Hennessy - Louis Vuitton, the world’s largest luxury group. A play on the words “can do”, Kendo has become the hub of creativity and next generation beauty product development for global Sephora channels and selective retailers outside of Sephora.

Through original development, collaborations and acquisitions the Kendo stable of brands will always be creative, inspiring and innovative. A dynamic engine of speed, expertise and market-savvy, the Kendo team continues to redefine the beauty industry through great product, great storytelling, great retail and direct-to-consumer partnerships. This shows up in everything we do and in what we stand for:

* “Can Do” Spirit: We work together to make our wildest dreams a reality: As entrepreneurs, we embrace optimism and find creative ways to reach our goals
* Advocacy, Diversity, and Inclusion: We recognize and celebrate the full spectrum of personal identities. We create safe spaces so everyone’s voice is heard. We listen with humility and act with courage.
* Storytelling: We tell authentic stories like no, one else. It’s our key to inspire trust and build relationships, rallying, our people, partners, and consumers around our brands.
* Resilience: We embrace challenges as opportunities. Change is ever- constant, and agility is our strength.
* Product Excellence: We put the consumers first: We constantly raise the bar to create products of the highest quality that everyone just has to have.
  

The salary range for this temp position is $43.30 - $56.00 per hour. Offered salary is dependent upon experience and San Francisco location. This is a hybrid role based in our downtown San Francisco office – Tues through Thursday in-office, with Monday and Friday remote.

  

The Kendo house of brands currently includes: Fenty Beauty, Fenty Skin, Fenty Eau de Parfum, Fenty Hair, Ole Henriksen, Lip Lab.

  

**SUMMARY**

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Project Manager to join our creative team, supporting the Emerging Brands (Ole Henriksen & Lip Lab) divisions. This role is critical in ensuring the successful and timely execution of all creative projects. You’ll own GTM and digital timelines for the brands, serving as the creative team’s primary point of contact for print and digital projects. While embedded within the creative team due to the significant creative input required for most projects, this individual will be instrumental in fostering seamless collaboration between brand, marketing, and creative departments to ensure all initiatives launch on schedule with all necessary assets.

This role for creative Project Manager is a temporary position.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Partner with stakeholders across brand, marketing, and creative teams to define project scopes, establish timelines, and manage project lifecycles within Asana.
* Efficiently manage project intake and conversion processes within Workfront.
* Drive projects forward, proactively identifying and mitigating risks to ensure deadlines are met.
* Lead and facilitate weekly creative status, review and project kickoff meetings.
* Accurately capture, distribute, and follow up on meeting notes, action items, and other critical inter-team communications.
* Successfully manage a diverse portfolio of concurrent digital projects across multiple brands.
* Continuously identify opportunities for process improvements and workflow optimization to enhance team efficiency and project delivery.
  

**REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor’s degree
* 5+ years of progressive project management experience, with a strong preference for digital project management within a creative or marketing environment.
* Expert-level proficiency in project management software, including Asana and Adobe Creative Suite (specifically ProofHQ and Workfront).
* Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships and effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and diverse stakeholders.
* Exceptional organizational skills with a keen eye for detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* PMP Certification is a plus.

jobs.title: Program/Project Manager 5
jobs.description:
**The group you’ll be a part of**
---------------------------------

The Global Operations Group brings information systems, facilities, supply chain, logistics, and high-volume manufacturing together to drive the engine of our global business operations. We help Lam deliver industry-leading solutions with speed and efficiency, while actively supporting the resilient and profitable growth of Lam's business.

**The impact you’ll make**
--------------------------

The successful candidate will convert the ceramics strategy into an executable manufacturing roadmap, ensuring products are prioritized, capital and equipment are deployed on time, qualifications are completed, capacity is ready ahead of demand, and the organization successfully transitions into sustainable high-volume production. This directly supports the current roadmap from product selection and engineering through equipment installation, qualification, and production ramp.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Lead the end-to-end execution of the Silfex ceramics expansion program from product selection and technology development through qualification and production ramp.
* Build and manage the integrated program roadmap, milestones, critical path, risks, dependencies, and executive decision points.
* Drive alignment across Supply Chain, Engineering, Silfex Operations, Quality, Finance, Facilities, Product Groups, and external technology/supply partners.
* Lead CapEx, equipment and facility readiness, including requirements, approvals, procurement, installation and qualification.
* Coordinate the qualification and industrialization of progressively more complex ceramic components.
* Integrate demand, capacity, cost, equipment and qualification plans to ensure manufacturing capability is available ahead of production requirements.
* Establish strong program governance with clear ownership, decision rights, operating cadence, risk management, and executive reporting.
* Proactively identify execution gaps and drive mitigation and recovery plans to protect business and launch commitments.

**Who we’re looking for**
-------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Manufacturing, Materials Science, or related field.
* 12+ years of experience leading complex manufacturing, technology-transfer, supply-chain, or capital-equipment programs.
* Demonstrated ability to manage large, cross-functional programs from concept through qualification and production ramp.
* Strong experience with program management, critical-path management, CapEx deployment, risk management, and executive communication.
* Ability to influence and drive accountability across multiple organizations without direct authority.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* Semiconductor equipment, advanced ceramics, precision machining, advanced materials, or similar manufacturing experience preferred.
* Experience with supplier technology transfer or manufacturing vertical-integration programs is highly desirable.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Relevant project management certifications such as PMP, CAPM, Scrum Master, or PRINCE2.

**Our commitment**
------------------

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

  

Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.

  

*Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.*

*#LI-FT1*

CA San Francisco Bay Area Salary Range for this position: $114,000.00 - $253,000.00.

The above salary range for this position is relevant to applicants that reside or work onsite in the California, San Francisco Bay Area only. At Lam, our people make amazing things possible. That’s why we invest in you throughout the phases of your life with a comprehensive set of outstanding benefits.

jobs.description:
### **Company Description**

**Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!**

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.

### **Job Description**

We have an opening for a **Senior Control Account Manager** (CAM). You will be a member of the innovative Advanced Sources and Detection (ASD) Scorpius Project. The ASD project is a multi-year, multi-lab project to design and commission the next generation of radiographic capabilities for use in ensuring the safety and effectiveness of the nation’s nuclear stockpile. You will be responsible for maintaining, managing, measuring and reporting on the scope, budget, and schedule performance associated with the control accounts under your control. You will work with the Senior Team Lead and Technical Lead in implementing efficient management and execution operational practices and in developing strategies to address the needs of the project. The selected candidate will be expected to work closely with a partner labs’ Control Account Managers in incorporating, updating and consolidating the P6 schedules. This position is in the National Security Engineering Division (NSED) within the Engineering Directorate.

*This position offers a hybrid schedule, blending in-person and virtual presence. You will have the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week.*

This position will be filled at either level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the hiring team. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if hired at the higher level.

**You will**

* Contribute to the development and maintenance of project controls system architecture and components, including work processes, tools, and procedures and ensure data integrity and assess project controls data to verify compliance with processes and procedures using judgement within broadly defined policies.
* Conduct technical operational tasks of monitoring earned value performance data, develop complex data analysis, including variance analysis, recovery or corrective action plans, risk vetting, reporting, and estimate at completion analysis.
* Identify and provide solutions to cost trends and schedule impacts, use statistical tools to analyze metrics, and report cost, schedule, risk and earned value information formal meetings such as Management Reviews, Integrated Baseline Reviews, Design Reviews, and Earned Value Surveillance Reviews with in-depth analysis.
* Integrate project activities into total work scope for identification and maintenance of project critical path including performing and maintaining baseline change control management processes and logs.
* With minimal direction, use independent judgement to execute the project control system and implement on-the-job training for project controls processes.
* Perform and oversee complex statistical analysis, schedule monitoring, and computer operations, and coordinate comparisons of historical data, scope, quantities, and cost data between projects to drive toward successful project completion.
* Provide quarterly assessments of ASD activities to EIA-748C requirements and provide details for consideration/implementation.
* Report to project senior management weekly and monthly, contribute to the ASD Project Management Office with monthly cost and schedule performance status reporting to the Federal Project Director.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Additional job responsibilities, at the TSS.4 level**

* Provide subject matter expertise to prepare and present to internal and external organizations on demonstrations of the Earned Value Management System to foster adoption and broaden implementation and use.
* Use highly advanced concepts of Earned Value Management System (EVMS) and EIA-748C requirements as required by DOE O 413.3B and assure ASD LLNL activities are compliant with ASD EVMS requirements (Triad National Security EVMS will be followed).
* Provide recommendations/guidance on improving highly complex Earned Value Management processes.
* Lead and mentor other Control Account Managers and Project Control Specialists.

### **Qualifications**

* Ability to secure and maintain a U.S. DOE Q-level security clearance which requires U.S. citizenship.
* Bachelor's degree in relevant technical discipline, or related field, or an equivalent combination of education and previous relevant experience.
* Experience independently performing project control functions, including cost estimating, directing, planning, scheduling, development control, and analysis and solving complex problems in innovative and effective ways.
* Advanced level of general project control technical knowledge and skills and integration of all of the components of an Earned Value Management System, including organizational, planning, accounting, analysis, and revision of process areas.
* Significant experience performing statistical analysis, schedule monitoring, computer architecture, and operations to disseminate, create, and present highly detailed and complex financial information to diverse audiences.
* Experience in using project controls operating systems such as Primavera, Cobra, or MS Project, and advanced knowledge using Microsoft Office.
* Experience independently and successfully clarifying issues, analyzing concerns, and resolving complex problems and implementing sound decisions.

Requisition ID # 175842
  
  
**Job Category:** Project / Program Management
  
**Job Level:** Individual Contributor
  
**Business Unit:** Energy Delivery
  
**Work Type:** Hybrid
  
**Job Location:** San Francisco
  
  
Department Overview
  
Electric Transmission & Distribution ensures the delivery of clean, safe, reliable and affordable energy to nearly 16 million people in Northern and Central California. The Electric Transmission & Distribution Team, comprised of roughly 10,100 coworkers, is responsible for ensuring the electric grid's reliability and resiliency through the ongoing maintenance and operations of PG&E's 100,000 miles of distribution lines and over 18,000 miles of transmission lines.
  
  
Coworkers in Electric Transmission & Distribution actively engage in the Lean Methodology through the use of visual management in operating reviews to cross-functionally identify and solve problems, and create standard work. By working together as One Electric. One Team. We are delivering for our hometowns.
  
  
Position Summary
  
Manages aspects of program implementation and operations. Ensures program is operating effectively. The New Business PMO’s objectives are to develop, implement, and execute plans management of the New Business Work portfolio. The team is hybrid, working from your remote office and your assigned work location based on business need. There are five regional teams with assigned work locations within the PG&E Service Region (Bay, South Bay/Central Coast, Central Valley, North Coast, and North Valley/Sierra). This position is for the Bay Region.
  
  
This position is hybrid, working from your remote office and your assigned work location based on business need. The assigned work location will be within the Bay Area of the PG&E Service Territory. San Francisco/Peninsula preferred.
  
  
PG&E is providing the salary range that the company in good faith believes it might pay for this position at the time of the job posting. This compensation range is specific to the locality of the job. The actual salary paid to an individual will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, specific skills, education, licenses or certifications, experience, market value, geographic location, and internal equity. Although we estimate the successful candidate hired into this role will be placed towards the middle or entry point of the range, the decision will be made on a case-by-case basis related to these factors.
  
  
**Bay Minimum:** $129,000
  
**Bay Maximum:** $207,000
  
  
This job is also eligible to participate in PG&E’s discretionary incentive compensation programs.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  
Applies broad expertise and advanced knowledge to wide-ranging issues.
  
May act as a team lead and provide direction to less experienced employees.
  
Works with Directors and Managers across functions to influence decisions.
  
Communicate complex ideas to diverse audiences using a variety of systems and tools.
  
Integrates industry knowledge related to data into everyday business practices and decision making.
  
Provides others with guidance around complex industry regulatory and compliance environment and considerations.
  
Analyze complex project and operational data to identify trends, risks, and constraints, and provide data-driven recommendations to leadership.
  
Manage complex and mid-sized projects from initiation through execution, ensuring alignment with program objectives, schedules, budgets, and operational priorities.
  
Partner with regional and cross-functional teams to track performance, resolve execution challenges, and improve processes that support safe, timely, and efficient delivery of New Business work.
  
Develops new or revises existing scopes of work to ensure compliance standards and deliverables are established.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
**Minimum:**  
Bachelors Degree or equivalent experience
  
Job-related experience, 8 years
  
Travel may be required
  
  
**Desired:**  
Masters Degree in job-related discipline or equivalent experience
  
PMI-Project Management Institute PMP-Project Management Professional certification
  
Advanced knowledge of Program Management
  
Ability to influence leaders inside and outside of the department through data analysis, insights and recommendations
  
Ability to lead large and complex projects working with cross-functional teams
  
Ability to create compelling business cases based on complex business environments and inputs
  
Adept at addressing issues with diplomacy and tact
  
Excellent negotiation skills.
