The **Project Manager** (PM) position works closely with members of the Real Estate Development Department and other SAHA staff to promote, preserve and develop affordable housing in keeping with SAHA’s mission. The position is responsible for contributing to all stages of affordable housing development for two to three active development projects at any given time (depending on size, complexity, and development phase of the projects) and ensures that objectives of each project are accomplished within prescribed time frames and funding parameters.

This position requires the ability to work effectively in a face-paced environment in order to meet deadlines. A passion for the built environment combined with a commitment to social justice is a must.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities** include but are not limited to the following:

* Coordinates, oversees, and leads various stages of affordable housing development depending on experience and skill level, including feasibility analysis, pre-development, design, project financing, construction, loan close-out and transition to property management for up to three (3) development projects at any given time.
* Develops and manages relationships with federal, state and local funders, government agencies, community and neighborhood groups, development partners and industry professionals. Represents SAHA before government agencies, planning and zoning commissions, city council, and other community meetings to garner critical support and governmental approvals for potential projects.

**Project Manager Opportunity at Stanford Federal Credit Union!**

**We’re on a mission to improve financial lives!** If you’re a high-energy, compassionate, and collaborative individual with a desire to make a difference, we encourage you to consider joining our SFCU team! Members really do come first at Stanford FCU because we’re non-profit and owned by our members. Our members work for Stanford University or some of the most innovative companies in Silicon Valley—and we provide them with the most generous financial benefits in our industry.

Stanford FCU is a $4.5 billion company with a global reach of over 95,000 members in 90 countries and growing! Come grow with us and see what it’s like to work for a Bay Area Top Workplace. As a Project Manager at Stanford FCU, you will be an essential part of our dynamic team, steering the successful completion of critical projects that support our strategic goals. * Expertise in applying project management principles, methodologies, and tools to manage all project lifecycle phases.
* Capable of analyzing complex problems, identifying potential solutions, and making decisions based on data.
* Proven ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams, influence without authority, and drive projects to completion.
* Ability to identify, assess, and mitigate project risks, ensuring that projects stay on track.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and adapt to project scope, schedule, and resource changes.
* Proficient in negotiating terms and resolving conflicts, ensuring the project’s best interests are always front and center.
* Understanding budgeting and financial planning related to project management, with the ability to effectively forecast and control project costs.

**What YOU’LL do:**

* Responsible for preparing and executing project plans on approved projects.
* Oversees all aspects of projects, including due diligence, initiation, planning, execution, and closing stages.
* Manages and implements project changes/interventions to achieve completion.
* Conduct project post-implementation reviews. Coordinate and communicate effectively with various teams to meet project objectives.
* Resolve project issues, mitigate risks, and manage scope changes effectively.
* Facilitate regular status meetings and report project progress to stakeholders.
* Train and mentor internal staff members on project management methodologies and best practices.

* Quarterly incentives up to 10% of your salary (based on position)
* Employer 401(k) matching up to 5% plus additional annual discretionary contributions
* Education reimbursement based on eligibility
* Employee recognition program with cash incentives

* Paid Sick Time accrues at two weeks per year
* Paid Vacation Time accrues at three weeks per year
* Paid Federal banking holidays (approximately 11 per year)
* Ongoing training and education, seminars, and conferences
* Loan rate discounts on some products (vehicle, mortgage and HELOC loans)
* Waived fees and deposit bonuses on Stanford FCU accounts
* Flex health/transit plan availability

Stanford Federal Credit Union provides pay ranges representing its good faith estimate of what the Credit Union reasonably expects to pay for a position. jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About LCC3 Solution Inc**

LCC3 Solution Inc. provides industrial design-build services, including design coordination, procurement, construction management, installation, and commissioning for advanced manufacturing and high-tech facilities. We are seeking organized, proactive project assistants to support our Project Managers and grow within industrial construction.

**Position Summary**

Support the PM with daily coordination, written communication, schedules, procurement, cost records, and project documentation. This hands-on role supports industrial facilities, cleanrooms, and laboratory projects. Success means keeping accurate records, following up on commitments, and escalating issues early with a clear status and next action.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

***Project Coordination***

* Maintain action and issue logs with responsible parties, due dates, and status; follow up with owners, designers, subcontractors, and suppliers until items are resolved.
* Update schedules, milestones, and short-term lookaheads using field input; flag late approvals, missing owner information, design dependencies, and delivery risks to the PM.
* Coordinate meetings across U.S. and China time zones; prepare agendas, record decisions, and distribute minutes and follow-up actions.

***Subcontractor and Vendor Management***

* Prepare RFQs, organize quotations, and compile comparisons of scope, exclusions, price, lead time, and delivery terms for PM review.
* Prepare purchase order documentation for approval; track submittal approvals, fabrication, shipping, and delivery commitments, especially for long-lead equipment.
* Coordinate deliveries, site access, unloading, and storage with the field team; record shortages, damage, and outstanding supplier items.

***Documentation and Project Administration***

* Maintain organized contracts, drawings, revisions, RFIs, submittals, meeting minutes, and correspondence; distribute current documents and track responses and approvals.
* Follow up with U.S. Architects/Engineers and overseas design teams on drawing updates, owner inputs, and outstanding technical questions.
* Maintain a potential change order log; compile owner instructions, emails, drawing revisions, field records, quotations, and schedule impacts for PM review.
* Help prepare change order proposals, progress payment applications, schedule of values updates, and invoice tracking; check supporting documents and flag discrepancies.

***Site Support and Quality Assurance***

* Collect daily reports, progress photos, manpower information, and field constraints; compare reported progress with planned activities and notify the PM of deviations.
* Track permit and inspection status, required documents, and corrective actions with the field team and Architect/Engineer; support TCO/CO preparation and closeout.
* Maintain punch lists and coordinate testing and turnover records, including cleanroom test reports, equipment startup records, as-builts, warranties, and O&M manuals.
* Follow site safety requirements, use required PPE, and promptly report observed safety or quality concerns to the responsible field leader and PM.

***Communication and Reporting***

* Draft clear English and Mandarin emails, meeting summaries, and project updates; accurately communicate technical and commercial information between project teams.
* Prepare a concise weekly status report covering progress, procurement, pending decisions, changes, and risks; highlight items requiring PM action.
* Work under PM direction. Obtain approval before issuing commitments involving price, scope, schedule, or contract terms; route technical approvals to the responsible professionals.

**Required Qualifications**

* Fluent written and spoken English and Mandarin; able to draft professional emails and take accurate meeting minutes in both languages.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and persistent follow-up; able to manage competing deadlines and ask clear questions when information is incomplete.
* Proficiency in Excel, Word, Outlook, and Teams; able to maintain tracking spreadsheets, compare quotations, and organize project files.
* Comfort working with drawings, quantities, and basic construction terminology, with the ability to learn unfamiliar systems and identify questions for the PM.
* Ability to read design drawings and coordinate with design institutes
* Valid driver's license, reliable transportation, and ability to work on-site and travel between project locations as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 1–3 years of experience in construction, engineering, manufacturing, or project coordination; relevant internships will also be considered.
* Exposure to industrial, cleanroom, semiconductor, or laboratory projects, including mechanical, electrical, plumbing, or process utility coordination.
* Experience with RFIs, submittals, procurement, change orders, or payment applications; familiarity with Bluebeam, Procore, Microsoft Project, or similar tools.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to walk active construction sites, wear required PPE, travel between sites, and occasionally lift up to 25 pounds, with reasonable accommodation as applicable.

**What We Offer**

Competitive salary based on experience; company-sponsored benefits subject to eligibility; hands-on mentorship; and opportunities to grow into project engineering or project management responsibilities.

Pay: $67,487.52 - $81,275.30 per year

Benefits:

Education:

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Data Center Strategy & Planning
jobs.description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**THE ROLE:**

AMD is seeking a Senior Program Manager, Data Center Strategy & Planning to build and scale the processes, governance, and tools that underpin AMD's data center strategy and acquisition function. Based in Santa Clara, CA and reporting to the CVP, Data Center Strategy & Acquisition, this leader will own program management across capacity planning, data center provider, AI Lab and NeoCloud partner diligence, regional expansion, and cross-functional operating standards for one of AMD's strategically important growth initiatives.

In this highly visible role, you will partner closely with Corporate Development, GPUBU, Sales, Engineering, Legal, Government Affairs, and Security teams to ensure AMD's data center acquisition engine operates with the discipline, speed, and transparency the business requires. You will build the operating model for a fast-moving function, establish scalable processes and governance, evaluate data center capacity opportunities and partners, and provide executive visibility into capacity, capital, risk, and program status.

This position offers the opportunity to help shape a function from the ground up, work directly with senior leaders across AMD and its data center developer, AI Lab, and NeoCloud partners, and apply modern AI tools, including ChatGPT and Claude, to automate and scale a program central to AMD's growth strategy.

**THE PERSON:**

The ideal candidate is a builder who is energized by creating process and structure where none exists today and can move fluidly between hands-on program management and executive-level communication. You are equally comfortable managing a capacity plan tied to revenue goals, supporting due diligence on a data center provider's operational and financial maturity, and briefing executives on program status, often within the same week.

You possess strong organizational and analytical skills, a bias toward action, and the judgment to determine when processes need to be formalized versus kept lightweight. You thrive in ambiguous, fast-growth environments, are comfortable driving change across stakeholders who do not report directly to you, and are genuinely curious about how AI tools can remove friction from recurring work.

You are highly collaborative and able to build trusted relationships across Corporate Development, GPUBU business leadership, Sales, Engineering, Legal, Government Affairs, Security, and executive leadership.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Own data center capacity planning, ensuring capacity supports revenue goals and proactively managing changes to Ready-for-Service (RFS) timelines.

* Build and scale the Data Center Strategy & Acquisition operating model, including processes, governance, RACI, role clarity, and change management across the function.

* Develop standardized data center provider, AI Lab, and NeoCloud diligence, scorecards, intake, and onboarding processes to evaluate operational and financial maturity, capacity opportunities, and strategic partners.

* Establish the New Region Expansion process and business justification framework to enable consistent prioritization and investment decisions.

* Drive development and adoption of cross-functional acquisition standards, including lease templates and processes spanning Legal, Government Affairs, physical security, logical security, and cybersecurity.

* Identify opportunities to automate recurring workflows, analysis, and reporting using ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools.

**About Bill Wilson Center:**  
Bill Wilson Center provides services to children, youth, young adults, and families in Santa Clara County. Additionally, we reach clients through our street outreach and crisis line programs. Bill Wilson Center programs focus on housing, mental health care, supportive services, and advocacy. Bill Wilson Center is committed to working with the community to ensure that every youth has access to the range of services needed to grow to be healthy and self-sufficient adults. A key component of Bill Wilson Center's philosophy encompasses a strength-based approach to improving the lives of the youth and young families in our communities. The Site Operation Program Manager is an important part of the Enhanced Short-Term Residential Therapeutic Program (E-STRTP) management team supporting the agency mission and vision to help our most vulnerable population of foster youth achieve self-sufficiency and life skills needed towards reaching their unique hopes and dreams. **What we need to see:**

* 12+ years of technology sales experience, including at least 2 years passionate about engineering software, industrial design, simulation, AI, or high-tech enterprise solutions.
* Extensive experience working with business development, solution architects, developer relations, product management, and marketing teams to align with strategic accounts.
* Experience building relationships with founders and key technical and business leaders at ISVs, ideally in CAE, CAD, PLM, or industrial software.
* Strong account management skills, plus the technical depth to understand an ISV's software architecture, product roadmap, and go-to-market needs.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, the ability to explain technical concepts clearly, and strong leadership skills.
BS in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or equivalent experience.

jobs.title: Executive Experience Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way**.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

The Executive Experience Operations Specialist is the primary JLL operator for executive guest experience, ABP partnership, and onsite event support at the client's headquarter location. This is a hospitality-first role for someone who takes genuine ownership of the executive experience — from the moment a visitor steps through the door to the moment they leave — and who is equally committed to building and improving the program over time.

This individual serves as the dedicated JLL liaison for LT ABPs, owns the full executive guest experience layer across all Oyster Point programming, and partners closely with JLL Event & Workplace Coordinators, Engineering, Security, AV, Food Services, and Workplace Experience to ensure seamless, high-quality execution across all engagements. ### **LT ABP Liaison & Executive Partnership**

* Serve as the primary onsite JLL liaison for all Leadership Team Assistant Business Partners ( LT ABPs) — the dedicated, go-to contact for every meeting, event, and experience request.
* Build and maintain a proactive LT ABP-to-Workplace communication cadence, including regular and frequent communications on upcoming executive events, VIP arrivals, scheduling requirements, and any on-the-ground needs.
* Own the in-person experience layer that LT ABPs can no longer deliver directly following their transition to remote support — bridging that gap with precision, discretion, and a consistently high standard of care.
* Partner closely with LT ABPs to support C-suite and senior leadership visits, managing the full experience lifecycle from advance coordination through day-of execution.
* Develop and maintain a deep familiarity with the preferences, expectations, security requirements and working styles of the leadership team executives, enabling proactive and personalized service delivery.
* Act as a trusted bridge between the Workplace and LT ABP teams— driving synergy, reducing friction, and surfacing opportunities to improve the joint support model.
* Develop a deep understanding of executive preferences, working styles, and security requirements to deliver proactive, high-touch support.

### **Executive & Leadership Event Support**

* Serve as the Workplace Experience DRI for all EBCs
* Provide coordination / planning support for executive and leadership meetings at Oyster Point
* Owning the full in-person experience lifecycle: guest arrival and check-in, room readiness, catering coordination, VIP touches, and onsite execution through departure.
* Maintain the highest standard of white-glove service for VIP visits, C-suite engagements, and high-profile meetings — acting as the visible, composed face of hospitality for executive engagements.
* Manage weekly mail distribution for LT members based at Oyster Point, upon request from LT ABPs
* Coordinate proactively with LT ABPs, Security, and AV in advance of executive events to ensure full briefing, aligned coverage, and zero-gap execution on the day.

* Partner closely with the Events Operations team to ensure the full experience across every event is seamless: pre-event coordination, day-of execution, and post-event follow-through.
* Manage event tickets and workflows in client & JLL systems, maintaining accurate records with timely updates.
* Provide on-site event support for after-hours executive events when needed, ensuring consistent JLL presence without dependence on overtime escalation.

Facilities Operations Support

* 1–3 years of experience in event coordination, hospitality, executive support, workplace experience, or a combination.

**About the Team**

OpenAI’s Education team works with K-12 districts, colleges and universities to bring AI into teaching, learning, research, and campus operations. As OpenAI’s **first Enablement Lead dedicated to Education**, you’ll shape how we help colleges and universities build that expertise. This is a hands-on, customer-facing individual contributor role. You’ll design the learning programs, teach the first cohorts yourself, and work with campus partners to lead future cohorts independently.

ChatGPT Edu will be central to your work. You might help faculty redesign an assignment around a specific learning objective, guide student developers through an OpenAI API or Codex lab, or help a campus IT team evaluate an AI-assisted workflow. You’ll work with institutional leaders to decide what success looks like and return after the session to see what people are using, adapting, and teaching their peers.

Success in this role means accelerating customer confidence and value, increasing product adoption, helping customers progress toward production use, and turning lessons from individual engagements into resources and practices that benefit many customers.

jobs.description:
About GitHub: GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.  
Locations: In this role you can work from Remote, Japan  
Overview:

GitHub is seeking an experienced and customer-focused Senior Program Manager-Incident Coordinator to independently coordinate complex, high-risk and business-critical customer situations within the Incident Coordination team’s remit.

Senior Program Manager-Incident Coordinator provides leadership during urgent customer-impacting incidents, creating clarity in ambiguous situations, establishing ownership and aligning Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Reliability Engineering, Customer Success and other stakeholders around a clear path forward.

This role requires excellent judgement, composure and the ability to influence without direct authority. The Senior Program Manager-Incident Coordinator must be able to manage several competing workstreams, make explicit prioritization decisions and communicate complex technical situations clearly to customers, senior leaders and technical stakeholders.

The role extends beyond coordinating individual incidents. Senior Program Manager-Incident Coordinators use evidence from incidents and escalations to identify recurring risks, recommend improvements and deliver agreed changes within the incident coordination remit. They partner with accountable teams on broader product, support-process and customer-experience improvements.

Success is measured through effective incident coordination, sound prioritisation, timely and accurate customer communication, reliable handovers and follow-through on agreed actions. The role also contributes to shared improvements that reduce repeat customer impact, avoidable urgent demand and preventable executive escalations.

Responsibilities:

Strategic incident leadership

* Independently lead complex, high-risk customer incidents, prioritising by impact, urgency and risk.

* Create clarity and momentum when cause, ownership, recovery path or customer outcome is uncertain.

* Own coordination, communication, action tracking and handovers across the incident lifecycle.

* Establish clear technical ownership and coordinate workstreams, decisions, risks, dependencies and next steps. Engineering and Support remain accountable for technical decisions, remediation and resource commitments.

* Exercise sound judgement, challenge assumptions and adapt the response as evidence changes.

* Make competing priorities and trade-offs explicit, engaging specialist support or accountable leaders when needed.

Cross-functional leadership and influence

* Bring together the required internal teams and Microsoft partners to coordinate an effective response.

* Align stakeholders with different priorities, responsibilities and perspectives.

* Influence technical owners, senior stakeholders and partners without relying on direct authority.

* Resolve unclear ownership, identify alternative paths and escalate proportionately while maintaining productive relationships.

* Drive timely decisions, confirm accountable owners and track actions, risks and dependencies to completion.

* Act as a trusted operational adviser during executive-visible and high-pressure situations.

Customer and executive communication

* Translate complex technical information into concise, accurate and business-relevant updates.

* Separate confirmed facts from hypotheses, risks and unknowns.

* Set an effective communication cadence and tailor detail to each audience.

* Avoid speculation, unsupported recovery estimates and unrealistic commitments.

* Provide coordination and clarity on customer calls, managing expectations and supporting de-escalation.

* Lead difficult conversations while balancing customer advocacy with technical and operational constraints.

* Maintain stakeholder confidence while protecting responders from unnecessary distraction.

Incident intelligence and repeat-failure reduction

* Identify recurring patterns and systemic risks across incidents, customers, products and processes.

* Use evidence to define clear problems, insights and recommendations.

* Lead post-incident reviews focused on ownership, prevention and operational improvement.

* Agree corrective and preventative actions, owners and expected outcomes with accountable teams.

* Track significant actions to completion, acceptance or formal disposition, escalating stalled or unowned risks.

* Evaluate whether improvements reduce repeat incidents, customer impact and avoidable escalations.

Organisational and operational improvement

* Lead incident-coordination improvement projects and partner with accountable teams to implement agreed changes.

* Use incident and customer-impact evidence to influence product, engineering and operational priorities.

* Improve coordination processes, tooling, ownership, communication, handovers and disengagement practices.

* Identify automation and AI opportunities that increase consistency, effectiveness and scale.

* Develop outcome measures that show customer impact, operational risk and improvement progress.

* Create reusable operating practices, clarify ownership and share learning with partner teams.

Capability building

* Build and apply expertise across incident workflows and relevant product areas to clarify customer impact and support investigation.

* Train and onboard coordinators, sharing judgement and learning from complex incidents.

* Review incident communications, handovers and escalations to improve quality and consistency.

* Create reusable playbooks, standards and guidance that strengthen team capability without creating dependency on individuals.

jobs.title: Brand Operations Manager II
jobs.description:
**About Dutchie**

Founded in 2017, Dutchie is an all-in-one technology platform powering the cannabis industry with **Point of Sale**, **E-commerce**, **Payments**, and **Loyalty & Marketing**. Through our technology, we’re helping cannabis businesses start, operate, and grow with confidence.

With software that simplifies their operations, our customers can focus on what matters most—bringing the benefits of cannabis safely to consumers.

Dutchie aims to further support the positive societal change the cannabis industry brings to the world through wellness benefits, social justice, and empowering local communities through tax revenue. Powering thousands of dispensaries across 40+ markets throughout the United States and Canada, Dutchie is the leading technology company in the cannabis space and was named in Fast Company’s 10 Most Innovative Companies in North America and listed two years in a row on LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups.

Dutchie has raised over $600M in funding to date, backed by D1 Capital Partners, Tiger Global, Dragoneer, DFJ Growth, Thrive Capital, Howard Schultz, Snoop Dogg’s Casa Verde Capital, Gron Ventures, members of the founding team at DoorDash, Kevin Durant’s Thirty Five Ventures, and other notable angel investors.

#### **About This Role**

Dutchie is the leading technology platform powering the cannabis industry. Our Brands team is the connective tissue between cannabis brands and the thousands of dispensaries that carry, merchandise, and advertise their products. As the Brand Ops Manager, you will own the day-to-day operational relationship with our brand advertising customers, from onboarding through campaign launch and optimization. You will work side by side with our Ad Sales team, who are the primary drivers of new business and expansion, and your work supports those efforts.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for someone who combines campaign execution with sharp business judgment. Your primary mandate is to onboard new advertisers, configure their campaigns in Kevel, our ad serving platform, manage performance against each brand’s goals and retail and grow revenue via strategic campaign management. You will then turn campaign data into a clear narrative that you share with the customer, one that influences strategic changes to their approach and gives the Ad Sales team the insight to support upsell and expansion. In a single day you might lead an onboarding call, build a flight in Kevel, adjust bids and budgets across a portfolio of campaigns, and prepare a business review that connects ad performance to a brand’s revenue goals.

You will partner closely with the Ad Sales team and work alongside R&D and Analytics, representing the voice of the customer and helping shape the advertising products that are still being built. We will teach you the market, and we value strong advertising and customer skills above all. You will also use AI tools every day to work faster, from analysis to automation, and apply careful human judgment to everything they produce. Success requires someone who is self-sufficient, commercially minded, has strong attention to detail and comfortable owning a book of business.

#### **What You'll Do**

Customer Onboarding & Campaign Configuration

* Own onboarding for new advertising customers from handoff by the Ad Sales team through go-live, translating each brand’s goals, budget, and target markets into a campaign strategy and launch plan with clear milestones.
* Configure and traffic campaigns in Kevel, including flights, targeting, creative, budgets, bids, and pacing, with careful quality control at every step, using AI and automation where they save time.
* Train brand customers on Dutchie’s advertising tools and reporting through live sessions, documentation, and enablement materials.

Campaign Management & Optimization

* Support sales in building strategically sound proposals for new customers and upsell opportunities to aid in driving customer KPI’s. Act as the expert in campaign management strategy and execution - drive conversations with sales counterparts to set up campaigns for success before they go live.
* Manage a portfolio of live campaigns, monitoring pacing, delivery, CTR, CPC, and ROAS, and resolving under- or over-delivery before it affects customer results, and building AI-assisted workflows and automations that reduce manual monitoring and reporting.
* Adjust bids, budgets, targeting, and creative with a portfolio-level view, accounting for the downstream effects across competing campaigns and shared inventory.

Data Analysis & Customer Storytelling

* Analyze campaign, Share of Voice, and sales-impact data, using AI tools to move faster and your own judgment to verify the results, and turn it into a clear narrative that explains performance in terms of the customer’s business outcomes.
* Use data-backed recommendations to influence strategic changes, such as shifts in budget, targeting, or promotional timing, and equip the Ad Sales team with the analysis they need to drive upsell and expansion.
* Prepare and lead recurring business reviews with brand customers, often alongside the Ad Sales team, from day-to-day contacts to senior marketing and sales leaders.

Account Health & Ad Sales Partnership

* Own account health, spotting at-risk accounts early and surfacing expansion opportunities to the Ad Sales team, who lead renewal and upsell conversations.
* Apply a prioritization framework across a varied book of business, balancing onboarding, optimization, escalations, and growth work against competing deadlines.

Troubleshooting & Cross-Functional Partnership

* Serve as the first line of support for advertising issues, diagnosing root cause, resolving what you can independently, and escalating to Product, Engineering, and Analytics with clear, reproducible detail.
* Advocate for the customer by feeding structured, data-backed feedback into the advertising roadmap, and learn new features quickly so you can ope

jobs.title: Field Operations Manager
jobs.description:
FireMon delivers Network Security Policy Control for the Modern Enterprise.

Most enterprises run firewalls from multiple vendors alongside cloud security groups and microsegmentation platforms, and no single console can say whether it all works together. We believe policy is the control plane for network security: it defines what the environment should do, and the infrastructure carries it out. FireMon gives security teams one place to see, govern, and prove that their policy is doing what they intend, across on-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments.

The Field Operations & Enablement Manager makes FireMon's field team faster, more consistent, and better prepared in every customer and partner conversation. You'll own two connected areas: the operating rhythm of the field (process, data, forecasting, and tools) and the enablement program that gets sellers, sales engineers, and partners ready to win.

Why this role exists: Our best sellers win through sharper strategy, not more activity. This role spreads that edge across the whole field by turning deal insight, market knowledge, and commercial judgment into repeatable plays, coaching, and programs.

### **Responsibilities**

**Field** **O****perations**

* Drive adoption of the core field tech stack (Salesforce, sales engagement, Gong, deal registration, and content tools), working with the Salesforce Admin on the workflow and process changes that go-to-market (GTM) strategy, product launches, and pricing updates require.

* Design and maintain territory, account, and partner assignments with Sales and Channel leadership.

* Support the field operating cadence: forecast and pipeline reviews, territory and account planning, QBRs, sales kickoff, and regional meetings, including logistics.

* Build KPI dashboards and reports for the sales team on bookings, pipeline coverage, win rates, deal velocity, and partner-sourced revenue.

* Standardize deal desk inputs, including quoting (CPQ), approvals, and handoffs to Finance and CX.

* Analyze win/loss patterns, pricing outcomes, and field feedback, and bring data-backed findings to Product Marketing and Product Management.

* Sharpen ideal customer profiles (ICPs), account tiering, and target account plays, and find whitespace in the existing customer base.

**Sales** **E****nablement**

* Build and run a structured onboarding program that gets new sellers to first qualified pipeline within 90 days, backed by level-up learning and 1:1 or small-group sessions.

* Create a role-based training curriculum covering FireMon products, the security policy management market, buyer personas, discovery, and competitive positioning, with certification and ongoing reinforcement on core messaging, demos, and qualification methodology (for example, MEDDPICC).

* Partner with Product Marketing to turn GTM strategy, product launches, pricing and messaging updates, and win/loss findings into field-ready playbooks, value narratives, battlecards, and talk tracks.

* Extend enablement to channel partners through partner onboarding, certification paths, and co-selling resources.

* Own the sales content platform (such as Highspot or GTM Buddy): organize content by sales stage, persona, and use case, retire outdated assets, and track usage and deal influence so reps find current, approved material in under a minute.

* Partner with Sales leadership on deal and call reviews using Gong) and other GTM techs, track skill gaps, and measure enablement impact against ramp time, win rate, and quota attainment, adjusting programs based on what the data shows.

### **Required Skills and Experience**

* 5+ years in sales operations, revenue operations, or sales enablement at a B2B software company, with at least 2 years owning programs end to end.

* Hands-on Salesforce experience building reports, dashboards, and pipeline and forecast processes, plus the analytical judgment to turn messy data into a decision and a plan.

* A track record of building onboarding or training programs that measurably shortened ramp time or lifted win rates.

* Experience supporting enterprise sales motions with long cycles and multiple stakeholders.

* Strong facilitation and presentation skills, comfortable in front of sellers, sales engineers, and product teams and executives.

* Hands-on CPQ, Salesforce and enablement platform experience.

* Experience defining ideal customer profiles, account segmentation, or target account programs.

### **Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Background in cybersecurity, network security, or infrastructure software.

* Experience in a channel-led or partner-transacted sales model.

* Familiarity with MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or a similar methodology, and tools such as 6sense, Highspot, GTM Buddy, and ZoomInfo.

* Experience building playbooks and programs that change field behavior in a high-growth environment.

Hummingbird is a remote-first, fully distributed team united by the shared mission of helping fight financial crime. Since our launch in 2017, we’ve helped major financial institutions and tech-savvy trailblazers alike (e.g. Plaid, Raymond James, Crypto.com etc.) orchestrate their compliance programs through our thoughtfully designed, intuitive, AI powered compliance tools. We believe finding and stopping financial crime is a problem rooted in code, language and design, so we built the product that the heroes doing this work deserve.

We are customer-obsessed, and we love building and shipping great products. We set a high bar, challenge our assumptions, seek diverse opinions, and support each other to do our best work.

We do our best to write inclusive, descriptive and accurate job descriptions, but we’re not always perfect. If you’re interested in the role, **we’d love to hear from you even if you don’t feel like you meet everything we’re looking for**. We’re always iterating and improving, and it’s possible that your experience is even more impactful than we could have imagined.

**About the Role**

As an Implementation Manager (Contractor), you’ll be the engine behind successful customer launches at Hummingbird. This contract role, working roughly 20 hours per week, will be responsible for implementations end-to-end — translating real customer business and technical requirements into a thoughtfully configured Hummingbird platform that meets our clients’ use cases.

This is a role for someone who loves both structure and problem-solving: you’ll manage timelines and stakeholders while getting hands-on with platform configuration, integrations, and workflows. If you're drawn to turning complexity into clarity and seeing customers succeed, this role was built for you.

  

**What you’re looking to do:**

* **Welcome new Hummingbird customers with open arms.** As one of the key points-of-contact just after a new customer signs on, you understand the impact that your role has!
* **Dive deep into technical intricacies.** Our product is highly configurable. You enjoy solving complex problems, and communicating that in a way that simplifies and brings clarity
* **Own all aspects of implementation**. With the support of the CS team, you’ll be responsible for driving client satisfaction, project scope, change requests, project status tracking, coordination of internal tasks, and reporting of project KPIs
* **Configure the Hummingbird platform** to meet customer business and technical requirements, within product capabilities
* **Manage multiple implementations** in parallel, prioritizing effectively and proactively flagging risks, tradeoffs, or scope changes

  

**What we’re looking for:**

* You thrive in owning ambiguous implementation work and turning loose requirements into clear plans, decisions, and outcomes
* Experience configuring B2B enterprise SaaS platforms or technical products based on real customer business and technical needs (not just running project plans)
* A strong cross-functional collaborator who enjoys working across the Customer Success org - with Technical Solutions Engineers, Implementation Managers, and our Head of Delivery to get things shipped
* You're organized, proactive, and reliable — you manage your own priorities well and surface risks or blockers early
* Someone who’s energized by a fast-moving, evolving environment

**What’s in it for you:**

* **The chance to help have a real impact on how we deliver.**
* **Competitive hourly rate**.
* **Remote-first,** fully distributed company with flexible working hours.
* **Safe, respectful & comfortable** work environment with colleagues and leadership who prioritize diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. DMI is a leading provider of digital services and technology solutions, headquartered in Tysons Corner, VA. With a focus on end-to-end managed IT services, including managed mobility, cloud, cybersecurity, network operations, and application development, DMI supports public sector agencies and commercial enterprises around the globe. DMI, LLC is seeking an **IT Project Manager** to support the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) Application Management Support Services (AMSS) program. The successful candidate will lead the planning, execution, and delivery of strategic IT initiatives supporting mission-critical applications, enterprise systems, and infrastructure services within a federal environment. This position requires a proven project manager with experience leading IT projects, overseeing application transition and modernization efforts, and supporting contract transition activities in accordance with federal acquisition and operational requirements. The Project Manager will collaborate with government stakeholders, technical teams, subcontractors, and corporate leadership to ensure successful service delivery and continuous operational excellence.

  + Develop and manage project schedules, resource plans, budgets, risk registers, and performance metrics.

  + Facilitate status meetings, executive briefings, and stakeholder reviews.

  + Support contract phase-in and transition activities for newly awarded federal programs and task orders.

  + Serve as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact for government program managers and technical leadership.

  + Ensure compliance with federal security, privacy, and operational requirements.
  + Support audits, contract deliverables, quality assurance reviews, and corrective action initiatives.

**Job Description:**

The **Payments Implementation Manager** provides day-to-day leadership and direction for a team responsible for delivering successful payment implementations, conversions, and related projects for CSI clients. This role combines people leadership, payments expertise, implementation delivery, client relationship management, and cross-functional coordination to ensure projects are completed accurately, efficiently, and on schedule.

The manager will lead a team supporting a variety of payment solutions and projects, which may include debit cards, ATM services, wire transfers, digital wallets such as Apple Pay and Google Pay, card and ATM deconversions, core conversions, debit card plastics and card art, and instant payment solutions such as FedNow.

This individual will serve as a key point of leadership when projects or client issues require escalation, helping identify risks, connect the appropriate teams, and drive issues toward resolution. The ideal candidate brings experience within banking or financial services, payments, and implementations, along with strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.

**What You’ll Do**

* Provide day-to-day leadership and direction for a team of Payments Implementation professionals.
* Coach and develop employees through regular one-on-one meetings, feedback, training, and ongoing development.
* Hire, train, and support team members while helping ensure the team has the resources and tools necessary to succeed.
* Oversee implementation workload, project assignments, scheduling, and resource planning to support service levels and client commitments.
* Support payment implementation and conversion projects involving areas such as debit cards, ATMs, wire transfers, digital wallets, instant payments, card conversions/deconversions, and related payment solutions.
* Monitor project progress and help ensure implementations remain on schedule while identifying and escalating potential risks.
* Assist with client and financial institution escalations, coordinating with the appropriate teams to resolve issues effectively.

* 6–8+ years of relevant professional experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

* Demonstrated experience with payments and payment-related solutions, such as debit cards, ATMs, digital wallets, FedNow or other instant payments, or similar payment products.
* Experience supporting or leading client implementations, conversions, or complex projects.
* Demonstrated leadership experience through people management, team leadership, project leadership, mentoring, or similar responsibilities.

* Strong client-facing communication skills and the ability to navigate challenging or escalated situations.
* Proven ability to work effectively across multiple teams and connect the right stakeholders to drive issues and projects forward.
* Strong organizational, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Excel.
* Experience with Smartsheet is helpful but not required.
* Curiosity and openness to learning how tools such as Microsoft Copilot and AI can improve documentation, communication, research, and operational efficiency.
* Four-year college degree or equivalent professional experience.

**What Will Help You Stand Out**

* Direct experience implementing or supporting debit cards or ATM products.
* Experience implementing, supporting, or managing wire transfer products and services.
* Experience with Apple Pay, Google Pay, digital wallets, FedNow, or other instant payment solutions.
* Experience managing card or ATM conversions and deconversions.
* Experience working directly with banks, credit unions, or other financial institutions.
* Experience managing client escalations and coordinating resolution across Product, Development, Project Management, Customer Care, and Relationship Management teams.
* Previous experience leading an implementation or payment-focused team.

**Why This Role**

This is an opportunity to lead a team working at the intersection of banking, payments, technology, and client delivery. You’ll have the opportunity to develop employees, influence how payment implementations are delivered, solve complex client challenges, and collaborate with teams across CSI to continuously improve the client experience.

**About Cat5 Resources LLC**

Cat5 Resources is a diversified supplier of technical and operational services across the Southern US, Puerto Rico, and the US Virgin Islands.

In 2004, when Hurricane Charley devastated Florida, our CEO, Cindy Perez, received an out-of-the-blue call from a long-term telecom client in urgent need of help. Their other vendors could not deliver, so they turned to Cindy for assistance. She responded without hesitation, mobilizing a fleet of generators and emergency fuel to ensure the client’s critical infrastructure remained operational throughout the event.

In 2013, Cindy founded Cat5 Resources with a mission to provide reliable and innovative solutions for critical infrastructure resiliency. Since then, the Cat5 Resources team has consistently delivered exceptional customer service to clients nationwide. Over the years, Cat5 Resources has expanded its offerings to include Disaster Recovery Services, Operations and Maintenance, Civil, Electrical, and Construction, as well as Transportation and Logistics.

As a certified Woman-Owned Business, Cat5 Resources serves the entire Southern United States. In 2016, we extended our services into Puerto Rico with the launch of Cat5 Caribbean, focusing on critical infrastructure support in disaster-prone regions. jobs.description:
Overview:

**About DX**

DX helps companies build world-class engineering organizations by providing leaders with deep insights into developer experience and productivity. We are a bootstrapped, profitable company experiencing consistent, 3X year-over-year growth. Based in downtown Salt Lake City, we are trusted by customers like Etsy, Dropbox, Twilio, Pfizer, and Booking Holdings.

**The Team**

We’re a small, highly collaborative team of passionate, top performers focused on delivering real impact for both our customers and our company. As the Manager of the Strategic Customer Success teas, you will lead a group of exceptional Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to drive customer satisfaction, adoption, and retention. You’ll develop and execute customer success strategies that align with DX’s growth objectives while ensuring customer outcomes are prioritized.

You’ll be responsible for driving customer success, including the renewal and growth of ARR (Annual Recurring Revenue) within this segment. Working closely with the VP of Customer Experience and the CRO, you'll help shape a unified customer experience and create “unchurnable” customers.

**The Role**

This Manager will provide feedback, coaching and recommendations to CSMs in order to drive **program health** within customer accounts. Ensure the team is executing the DX CSM Playbook skillfully, gains mastery of the DX Product, and drives value to customers, resulting in renewal. Drive CSMs to be proactive, ensuring they are owning and taking accountability over the customer journey. Drive outcomes, program health, renewals and expansion within assigned personal portfolio.

Responsibilities:

* **Team leadership & development:** Onboard and continuously develop your team of CSMs, helping them become subject matter experts on DX products and services. Provide coaching, feedback, and mentoring to ensure a superior customer experience and team success.
* **Drive customer outcomes:** Empower your team to focus on customer outcomes while achieving quarterly and annual targets for net renewals, retention, and expansion.
* **Customer health & risk management:** Proactively monitor customer health and implement risk mitigation strategies to ensure high renewal rates.
* **Upsell and expansion:** Build relationships with key customers, uncover opportunities for expansion, and ensure that customer value is consistently delivered.
* **Cross-functional collaboration:** Collaborate with Sales, Product, and other departments to enhance the customer experience and drive customer success.

**Zone A**: $174,750 - $228,146

**Zone B**: $157,275 - $205,331

**Zone C**: $145,043 - $189,361

Qualifications:

**About You**

* You consistently perform at a high level and are meticulous in your approach to customer success.
* You thrive in high-pressure environments, owning your responsibilities and meeting deadlines.
* You are quick to learn and articulate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* You have strong communication and relationship-building skills, able to influence at all levels of management.
* You excel at managing teams, with a proven ability to mentor, coach, and motivate others toward achieving results.
* You are a cross-functional collaborator, able to work closely with sales, product, and other teams to achieve common goals.

* Have past startup experience
* Have past experience working with a technical audience (Platform Engineering, VP Engineering, CTO, CIO)

And there’s a lot more!

**Job Summary**

TODC works exclusively with McDonald's, managing the DoorDash and Uber Eats businesses of McDonald's operators. We build and maintain our own local LLMs to optimize that performance. The Enterprise Account Manager (EAM) owns and grows relationships with our largest and most strategic McDonald's accounts, serving as their trusted advisor and primary point of contact for delivery performance.

The Enterprise Account Manager (EAM) takes extreme ownership of client outcomes. They meet with each customer monthly to review performance, identify opportunities for operational improvement, and keep a close eye on how marketing campaigns are performing on both platforms. They build and execute account strategies, lead implementation of the TODC Hyperlocal Strategy, and partner with cross-functional teams to deliver maximum value.

Our account managers act as translators: they take raw data and turn it into business insights that are valuable for the customer. TODC does not build dashboards, because dashboards allow customer relationships to atrophy. We rely instead on the professionalism and expertise of this role to build trust.

**Fully remote, U.S.-based position.** We are looking for a very hard-working, self-driven problem solver. Success in this role requires strong customer management skills, a mathematical mindset, and fluency in Excel or Google Sheets to test and adjust marketing for optimal outcomes. The EAM is also responsible for retaining customers and for expanding the business by generating referrals from clients.

  + Build long-term, trusted partnerships that lead to satisfaction, retention, and expansion.

  + Keep a close eye on the performance of marketing campaigns across DoorDash and Uber Eats.

  + Work with the local LLMs that TODC builds and maintains in-house, using their analysis and recommendations to optimize client performance.
* ### **Collaborate Across TODC**

  + Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Growth & Analytics, and Product teams.
  + Align internal resources to deliver maximum value and help expand clients' delivery businesses.
* ### **Lead Negotiations and Engagements**

  + Manage contract renewals, pricing discussions, and enterprise-level negotiations.
  + Act as a trusted escalation point, ensuring challenges are resolved quickly and effectively.
  + Represent TODC at industry events, conferences, and client-facing opportunities to build credibility and strengthen relationships.
* ### **Other Duties**

  + Perform miscellaneous duties and projects as assigned and required by the management team.

**Who You Are**

* Extreme ownership of outcomes: assumes full accountability for client results, individual performance, and overall team goals.
* Very hard-working and self-driven, with a strong drive to succeed and the ability to work independently.
* Proactive problem solver with strong critical-thinking abilities and a proven track record of finding solutions and making decisions that support the business.
* Mathematically inclined: comfortable working with numbers, interpreting performance data, and drawing conclusions from test results.
* Able to translate raw data into clear business insights, and to present them with the professionalism and expertise that earn customer trust.
* Well versed in Excel or Google Sheets, using them to analyze campaign performance and to test and adjust marketing for optimal outcomes.
* Comfortable with AI: TODC builds and maintains its own local LLMs, and the EAM must be at ease using AI tools in day-to-day work.

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager - xMatters
jobs.description:
The **Customer Success Manager (CSM)** is a customer-facing technical role within the Global Account Management and Customer Success organization. This role helps strategic xMatters customers adopt the solution, realize value, and achieve their business goals, supporting customer retention and growth.

As part of the Account Management team, the CSM drives xMatters adoption, value realization, customer satisfaction, and retention across an assigned portfolio. The CSM works across the organization as the voice of the customer, sharing feedback and helping remove barriers to adoption and success.

The CSM is a technical subject matter expert in xMatters and its use cases. In partnership with Account Managers, the CSM shares best practices, provides strategic guidance, and helps customers address complex challenges. The CSM also coordinates internal resources for at-risk customers and contributes to a strong, lasting customer experience.

### **What you'll do:**

Build deep technical and business knowledge of xMatters and its use cases. Work directly with customers to configure functionality, demonstrate capabilities, and identify additional ways to use the solution.

Lead adoption and customer success for assigned strategic xMatters accounts in support of retention and growth goals.

Apply knowledge of the industry, customer operations, and emerging needs to recommend relevant xMatters use cases. Develop practical adoption strategies that align with each customer’s goals.

Develop and lead adoption plans that support customer satisfaction goals, including an NPS score above 50. Monitor progress, identify product or business barriers, and coordinate actions to resolve them.

Review customer health and usage metrics, and develop processes and tools that improve xMatters adoption.

Partner with Account Managers on account plans, customer business challenges, risk mitigation, and opportunities to grow relationships.

Coordinate internal teams to resolve complex customer issues.

* Conduct customer health checks by reviewing progress against documented success criteria. Present findings and recommendations that help customers increase the value and use of xMatters.

* Develop practical approaches for customers whose needs are not met by standard configurations, working within product capabilities and established processes.

* Identify potential upsell and cross-sell opportunities through customer success conversations, and refer them to the assigned Account Executive or Account Manager for follow-up.

* Lead customer communications about xMatters product introductions, releases, enhancements, user group meetings, webinars, and other strategic initiatives.

* Share customer feedback with management and contribute to strategic initiatives and program improvements, including coordination with Product on feature requests and roadmap priorities.

* Partner with Implementation and Professional Services teams to understand the status of xMatters engagements and support a smooth transition from deployment to ongoing account management and customer success.

* Work with Product Management to prioritize customer feature requests, identify capability gaps, and communicate product barriers to adoption and effective use.

### **What you'll bring:**

* At least 3 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as pre-sales engineering or consulting, or implementing technical software solutions in DevOps, or major incident management (MIM).

* Experience providing technical account management for large organizations.

* Ability to connect product capabilities to customer needs, explain technical concepts clearly, and recommend ways to improve adoption and deliver measurable value.

* A track record of improving customer retention and growth through a customer-first approach in a complex software environment.

* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate challenging situations professionally with customers and internal teams.

* Strong organization and judgment, with the ability to prioritize work across multiple customers and adjust as needs change.

* Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to engage effectively with executive and C-level stakeholders.

* Ability to work independently with integrity and accountability.

* Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

* Resilience, curiosity, and a customer-first mindset. Builds trust with customers and colleagues and contributes to shared team success.

* Technical experience with agile delivery, CI/CD, SaaS or cloud environments, REST web services, Java or JavaScript (or other programming experience), ITIL, MIM, NOC or incident processes, and operations monitoring.

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology or a related field.

### **Bonus to have:**

BLACK LABEL is a white-glove procurement, design and technical-support partner for commercial cultivators and extraction labs across North America. As a 100% B2B company, we supply multi-state operators, single-state cultivators and extraction labs with everything from lighting, irrigation, fertigation, airflow, racking, substrates and IPM to extraction equipment and solvents, and we help them design and build out their facilities. Our customers count on us for a VIP experience: expert guidance, precision and follow-through on every order. We are a small, highly committed team that runs on responsiveness, accountability and customer-first thinking.

**The Role**

We are hiring a Commercial Account Manager (CAM) to own and grow a book of commercial accounts. You will own each relationship end to end, including service, retention and account health, and you carry responsibility for growing revenue and gross profit in that book, alongside new business you develop yourself. This is a fully remote, full-time role, Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time.

This is a sales-led role. It is a strong fit for someone who is consultative, commercially minded and motivated by an uncapped commission, and who still makes every customer feel taken care of. You do not need to be a cultivation or extraction expert on day one. Experience in the industry is a real advantage.

**What You Will Do**

* Own the commercial relationship for every account in your assigned book

* Set customer pricing at your own discretion above the company's gross margin floor, and convert quotes to live orders
* Select which vendors and manufacturers to source a project from, and negotiate cost with them
* Commit the company on lead times and delivery dates to your customers
* Work with our vendor and manufacturer partners on availability and technical support
* Maintain account health through responsiveness, issue resolution and proactive service
* Keep accurate records in Zoho CRM, Zoho Projects and Zoho Desk, and follow company SOPs
* Represent BLACK LABEL as the single point of accountability for your customers

**What We Are Looking For**

* Comfort with business software. Experience with a CRM (Zoho, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar) is a plus
* Self-motivated and dependable in a fully remote environment, with excellent written and verbal communication
* Experience in Controlled Environment Agriculture, horticulture, cannabis, extraction, or a related supply or procurement field is a strong plus

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Base salary of $70,000 per year
* Uncapped commission on the gross profit growth you generate: 15% on the first $70,000 of commissionable gross profit each calendar year, 20% on the next $70,000, and 25% on everything above $140,000. Full new-account gross profit is commissioned from the first dollar

* 15 paid vacation days and 5 paid sick days per year
* 7 paid company holidays, plus 3 days of bereavement leave

This is a full-time role, open to remote candidates or in our Spring Valley, NY office, working Eastern Time (EST) hours. It suits someone organized and customer-focused who likes being the person everyone counts on to get things done.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

* Act as the day-to-day point of contact for customers assigned to your outside sales reps.
* Prepare quotes, price lookups and product options based on rep and customer requests.
* Enter, process and track orders from quote through delivery, and keep customers updated on status.
* Follow up on open quotes and pending orders to help reps close deals.
* Coordinate with purchasing, warehouse, shipping and service teams to resolve delays, backorders and issues.
* Handle customer calls and emails promptly when reps are in the field.
* Keep account records, notes and contact details accurate in our systems.
* Spot reorder and upsell opportunities and pass them to the rep.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Required**

* 2+ years of foodservice equipment sales experience (account management, inside sales or sales support).
* Strong organization and follow-through; able to juggle many open orders and requests at once.
* Clear, professional phone and email communication.
* Hands-on experience building quotes in AutoQuotes (AQ), plus comfort with Microsoft Office and an ERP or order system.
* Team player who enjoys supporting others and solving problems.

jobs.title: Revenue Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
**JOB OVERVIEW**

Legion builds AI-powered workforce management software for enterprises that run hourly workforces in retail, hospitality, facilities management, and manufacturing.

We're hiring a Revenue Enablement Manager to own how our go-to-market team learns, sells, and improves. You'll build onboarding that shortens ramp, run the enablement cadence, launch new products to the field, and reinforce a consistent sales methodology. You'll measure all of it against productivity, win rate, and pipeline outcomes.

This is a builder role. You'll work across Sales, Solution Consulting, Marketing, Product, Partnerships, and RevOps, and you'll be the field's single point of contact for what to know and how to sell it.

**RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES**

Onboarding and ramp

* Own new-hire onboarding for AEs, AMs, SDRs, and SCs, with clear milestones and visibility into ramp progress
* Build role-based certifications that confirm readiness before reps run deals on their own

Curriculum and training

* Design and deliver curriculum across five domains: company, function, industry, product, and selling skills
* Map content to how reps work: manage, prospect, present, collaborate, sell, and deliver
* Run the bi-weekly enablement session and feed the enablement segment of weekly team meetings

Sales methodology and process

* Reinforce a consistent methodology and drive adherence to the sales process
* Equip Account Executives for deal and forecast reviews
* Build skills in prospecting

Content, playbooks, and knowledge

* Build and maintain playbooks, competitive intelligence, and messaging by industry and persona
* Own knowledge management so the field finds the right content fast

Partners and the wider GTM team

* Enable partners on co-sell and "Better Together" storytelling
* Extend enablement to CSMs, delivery, and support where it drives customer outcomes

Tools and measurement

* Drive adoption and ROI of the sales tool stack, partnering with RevOps
* Report enablement impact against ramp time, quota attainment, win rate, sales cycle, and pipeline progression

**REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5+ years in B2B SaaS, with 3+ in sales or revenue enablement
* Experience enabling enterprise sales teams on complex, multi-stakeholder deals
* Working knowledge of a qualification methodology such as MEDDPICC
* Strong curriculum design and facilitation skills, live and virtual
* Comfort with Salesforce and enablement or conversation-intelligence platforms
* Ability to tie programs to revenue metrics and report on them
* Clear writing and the credibility to coach AEs and work with executives

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES**

* Background in workforce management, HCM, or software sold into retail, hospitality, facilities management, or manufacturing
* Prior quota-carrying or solution consulting experience
* Experience enabling channel or alliance partners
* Experience running product launches with Product Marketing
* Familiarity with AI products and helping sellers position them

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

***Salary Range:*** **$130,000 - $150,000** ***+ Bonus (if applicable) +*** ***Stock Equity***

At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.

Our posted salary range is done so in good faith based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. We strive to make competitive offers that allow employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant's location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and the internal equity for the same position within the company.

Benefits include, but are not limited to:

* $0 monthly premium and other flexible medical, dental, and vision plans effective on the first day of employment
* 401k plan
* Discretionary Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
* Parental Leave
* Equity
* Monthly Wellness Reimbursement
* Monthly Lunch on Legion

### **ABOUT LEGION**

Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.

Legion Technologies delivers the industry's most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It's proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love.

If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.

### **BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY**

There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion's mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly work

jobs.description:
Job Summary:

**Join a Top-Rated Healthcare Company Making a Difference in Senior Care!**

WellBe Senior Medical was founded in 2019 to provide a more effective and personalized healthcare experience for patients living with chronic conditions. Our home-based medical visits nurture all aspects of a patient’s well-being so they can live better, feel healthier, and stay independent longer. With our mission at the forefront of everything we do, we aim to build our team with the most capable and compassionate individuals we can find. Named a Best Place to Work from Modern Healthcare, WellBe is a leading provider of in-home medical care and mental health services across the country!

Job Description:

**What Telehealth - Nurse Practitioners Love About WellBe:**

* Competitive salary and full benefits package. (110,000-$130,000)
* Meaningful, one-on-one care with your own patient panel.
* Mileage reimbursement

**WellBe’s Culture is Welcoming:**

* Be part of something important:
* + Be part of pioneering a new way of healthcare that is revolutionizing the industry.
  + A patient-focused environment that ensures patients can live a fulfilling life whatever their health level is. Our focus is to give our patients more good days.
* Give yourself incredible opportunities:

* Minimum of Master’s Degree, Nursing with focus on Family Nurse Practitioner, Adult Nurse Practitioner, Acute Care Nurse Practitioner, Geriatric Nurse Practitioner or Adult-Geriatric Nurse Practitioner from an accredited, Nurse Practitioner program (required)

* Active, unencumbered Nurse Practitioner license in the state of job posting and must reside in state (required)

* CPR certification (required)
* Active, unencumbered DEA licensure or eligibility to obtain (required)

* Have a valid driver’s license, car insurance, have access to a car and willingness to drive to patient homes as site of care delivery
* Requires homes visits to patients in a variety of residential settings
* Requires proof of an active auto insurance policy (required)

**Telehealth – Nurse Practitioner Skills and Abilities:**

* Ability to conduct in- home setting visits and have previous experience on a telehealth platform
* Demonstrated role proficiency with Microsoft Office; Excel, Word, G-suite, etc.
