jobs.title: Healthcare Technology Solutions Specialist
jobs.description:
GeBBS Healthcare Solutions is a leading provider of technology-enabled Revenue Cycle Management and Risk Adjustment solutions for healthcare organizations. GeBBS combines deep healthcare operational expertise with advanced technology, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions to improve financial performance, streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, strengthen compliance, and enhance revenue cycle outcomes.

Our solutions support healthcare organizations across the revenue cycle, including patient access, Health Information Management, medical coding, billing, denials management, accounts receivable, and other critical RCM functions.

GeBBS Healthcare Solutions is seeking an experienced **Healthcare Technology Solutions Specialist** to support our pre-sales and Product Development efforts. This is a client-facing role responsible for understanding prospective and existing clients' Revenue Cycle Management challenges and helping design technology solutions that address their operational and business needs.

The consultant will work closely with clients and GeBBS leadership to conduct discovery, assess current RCM workflows, identify operational challenges and opportunities, and determine how GeBBS technology and services can best address those needs. The consultant will then work across Product, Technology, Operations, and other internal teams to translate client requirements into practical technology solutions.

The ideal candidate will bring strong end-to-end RCM knowledge across front, middle, and back-end revenue cycle functions along with the communication and consultative skills needed to work directly with clients. This individual must be able to understand how a client's revenue cycle operates today, identify where challenges exist, ask the right questions, and help develop a technology-enabled solution that improves performance, productivity, accuracy, and financial outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client Discovery and Pre-Sales Consulting**

* Participate in discovery and pre-sales meetings with prospective and existing clients.
* Work directly with clients to understand their current RCM environment, workflows, operational challenges, technology, performance expectations, and business objectives.
* Ask detailed discovery questions to identify workflow gaps, pain points, inefficiencies, and opportunities for technology enablement.
* Assess client needs across front, middle, and back-end RCM functions.
* Understand the client's current-state processes and help define an appropriate future-state workflow.
* Translate client needs into clear business, operational, and technology requirements.
* Partner with GeBBS leadership and internal subject matter experts to determine the appropriate combination of technology, automation, and RCM services for each client.
* Help develop solution recommendations based on the client's specific needs rather than applying a one-size-fits-all approach.
* Support pre-sales presentations, solution discussions, product demonstrations, and other client-facing activities.
* Clearly communicate proposed solutions and workflows to client stakeholders.
* Help validate that proposed solutions address the client's identified requirements and operational challenges.

**RCM Workflow and Solution Expertise**

* Serve as an RCM subject matter expert throughout the pre-sales and solution-development process.
* Evaluate end-to-end revenue cycle workflows across front, middle, and back-end functions.
* Provide expertise in areas including patient access, eligibility and authorization, Health Information Management, medical coding, billing, claims management, denials, accounts receivable, and reimbursement.
* Understand how individual RCM functions interact and how changes in one area may impact downstream processes and financial performance.
* Identify workflow dependencies, operational bottlenecks, exceptions, and opportunities for improvement.
* Evaluate existing client workflows and recommend opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve accuracy, increase productivity, and streamline operations.
* Ensure proposed technology solutions align with real-world healthcare operational, reimbursement, quality, and compliance requirements.

**Solution Design and Technology Alignment**

* Work closely with Product Development, Technology, Operations, Compliance, Coding, and other internal teams to develop solutions based on client requirements.
* Translate client discovery findings into functional requirements, workflow documentation, use cases, and solution requirements.
* Help determine how GeBBS technology, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled workflows can be applied to address client needs.
* Review proposed solutions from both an RCM operational and client perspective to identify potential workflow gaps or risks.
* Provide operational guidance during solution design and development.
* Partner with technical teams to ensure proposed workflows account for healthcare-specific requirements and operational exceptions.
* Support solution validation, workflow reviews, and user acceptance testing when applicable.
* Provide feedback from client discovery and pre-sales activities to Product Development to help inform future product enhancements.

**Productivity and Performance Analysis**

* Evaluate client workflows to understand current productivity, quality, turnaround time, and performance expectations.
* Assess applicable productivity measures, including charts per hour (CPH), based on workflow complexity, specialty, encounter type, technology utilization, and quality requirements.
* Help establish realistic performance expectations for proposed technology-enabled workflows.
* Identify appropriate operational KPIs and measures of success for proposed solutions.
* Evaluate how automation and technology may impact productivity, accuracy, turnaround time, staffing requirements, and operational efficiency.
* Balance productivity improvements with coding accur

jobs.description:

Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be employed by Lyra Clinical Associates.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced mental health evaluator with a passion for delivering premium solutions to clients, customers, and vendors for all their evaluation needs. You will support the growth of our newly revamped Leaves & Evaluations Team by providing evaluations anchored in collaboration, simplicity, and transparency. Evaluations you will be completing include short-term disability and substance use evaluations, as well as additional assessment and documentation services (e.g., requests for accommodations or readiness to return to work).

This position is fully remote and is an independent contributor role.  
**Responsibilities**

* Conduct comprehensive, virtual mental health evaluations and case management

* Consult with a team of evaluators, case managers, and operations peers in regular 1:1s and group consultations

* Provide ongoing care collaboration to clients, employers, vendors, and key stakeholders, including submitting paperwork, supporting treatment recommendations, answers questions, and connecting to appropriate Lyra resources

* Other duties as assigned

**Qualifications**

* PhD or PsyD in clinical or counseling psychology from an accredited program

* Unrestricted license in any US state (priority given to PSYPACT authorized applicants; PSYPACT-eligible applicants; or applicants licensed in New York, Massachusetts, or Oregon)

* Completion of a supervised APA-accredited internship

* Willingness to become cross-licensed in a minimum of at least two additional states

* Able to demonstrate 5+ years of experience completing comprehensive evaluations for clients (e.g., disability evaluations, substance use evaluations, workplace accommodations letters, etc.)

* Comfortable using technology to deliver care and assessments virtually

* Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis

* Independent, open-minded, non-judgmental, compassionate, and flexible

* Excellent time management skills

* Excellent interpersonal skills (speaking and listening)

As a full-time Clinical Quality Lead, you will be employed by Lyra Clinical Associates P.C. The anticipated annual base salary range for this full-time position is $148,000. The base range is determined by role and level, and placement within the range will depend on a number of job-related factors, including but not limited to your skills, qualifications, experience and location.

Annual salary is only one part of an employee’s total compensation package at Lyra. We also offer generous benefits that include:

* Comprehensive healthcare coverage (including medical, dental, vision, FSA/HSA, life and disability insurances)

* Competitive time off with pay policies including vacation, sick days, and company holidays

* Paid parental leave

* 401K with up to 3% matching

* Monthly tech allowance

* We like to spread joy throughout the year with well-being perks and activities, surprise swag, regular community celebration…and more!

We can’t wait to meet you.

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

Are you technically minded, detail-oriented, and interested in helping customers successfully implement and connect new technology? CSI is seeking a **Technical Implementation Specialist** to support the hands-on installation, configuration, integration, deployment, and validation of CSI software for new and existing customers. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys a blend of **technical implementation, SQL, data integration, troubleshooting, and customer interaction**. You’ll work with technical environments, databases, data exchanges, connectivity, APIs, and system interfaces while partnering with customers and internal teams to ensure successful implementations.

**In This Role**

You’ll be responsible for accurately and efficiently completing assigned technical implementation activities using established processes and procedures. You’ll troubleshoot technical issues, validate data and integrations, support deployments and go-lives, and escalate more complex issues when needed.

**What You’ll Do**

* Perform technical environment setup and standard software installation and configuration.
* Build, run, and validate flat-file extracts based on defined specifications.
* Verify record counts, file layouts, and data quality before delivery.
* Run SQL queries and scripts to validate, troubleshoot, and correct converted data.
* Assist with configuring, testing, and validating file-based and API integrations between CSI solutions and customer or third-party systems.
* Troubleshoot installation, connectivity, file-transfer, data, and configuration issues and escalate more complex problems when needed.
* Support deployment and go-live activities, including cutover tasks and post-deployment validation.
* Deploy code, configuration packages, or releases to test environments when required by the solution or implementation process.
* Document technical configurations, file specifications, testing results, and issue-resolution steps.
* Communicate directly with customer technical contacts while working with senior team members and internal partners.
* Stay current on relevant CSI products, technical standards, and product enhancements.
* Travel as needed to support customer implementations and business needs.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**What We’re Looking For**

* At least 2 years of relevant experience in technical implementation, systems administration, data integration, technical support, or a comparable technical role.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
* Experience or familiarity with secure file transfer and file-based data formats.
* Understanding of server operating environments and network connectivity.
* Familiarity with APIs and system integrations is beneficial.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to follow technical specifications and established implementation procedures while recognizing when an issue should be escalated.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with data conversions, integrations, and validation.
* Ability to communicate technical information effectively with customers and internal teams.
* Education or job knowledge equivalent to an undergraduate education in a technical discipline, or equivalent technical experience or certifications.

**What Makes Someone Successful in This Role**

* You enjoy getting into the technical details and figuring out why something isn't working.
* You're comfortable working with data, SQL, files, integrations, connectivity, and system configurations.
* You can follow a defined process while still using critical thinking to identify potential issues.
* You're organized and comfortable balancing multiple implementation tasks and deadlines.
* You communicate well with both technical teams and customers.
* You're eager to continue developing your technical knowledge and grow into increasingly complex implementation work.

Building on its 60-year track record of personalized service, CSI is shaping the future of banking and empowering its customers to rival their competition. **Company Overview**
====================

Deepgram is bringing the world’s most natural interface, voice, to the technology we use every day. Our speech models and real-time infrastructure power AI systems that keep up with the way people actually speak. More than 5,000 organizations run conversational voice AI on Deepgram in production, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box.

The Deepgram Voice Agent Platform brings together speech-to-text, text-to-speech and speech-to-speech, with voice-native foundation models available through cloud APIs or self-hosted and on-premises deployments. Built for accuracy, low latency and cost efficiency, Deepgram makes high-quality voice experiences practical to build and run at scale. More than 650,000 developers have used Deepgram to process more than 200,000 years of audio. Every day, more of the world’s conversations with AI run on our models.

**Operating Principles**
========================

Deepgram is a research company that productizes as fast as possible. Four Operating Principles shape how we think, decide, and work together:

* Compress before you communicate. You think it through first, then lead with the bottom line.

* Resist entropy. You question what already exists before adding more process or tools.

* Solve the category. You fix recurring problems at the source, not one case at a time.

* Keep pace. Models and tools change every month, and so will your work. You adopt what’s new quickly and drop what no longer earns its place.

jobs.description:
**Location**

**Employment Type**

**Location Type**

**Department**

Strategy & Operations

  

**We're building a new healthcare clearinghouse**
=================================================

Stedi is the only headless clearinghouse and RCM engine. Headless means every part of our product is accessible via API. Developers and AI agents build their own interface on top of it. By offering modern, AI-ready APIs alongside traditional real-time and batch EDI processes, we enable both healthcare technology businesses and established players to exchange mission-critical transactions. Our clearinghouse product and customer-first approach have set us apart. Stedi was ranked by Ramp as one of the fastest-growing SaaS vendors.

Stedi has lightning in a bottle: engineers and designers shipping products week in and week out; a lean business team supporting the company's infrastructure; a passion for automation and eliminating toil; and $142 million in funding from top investors like Stripe, Addition, USV, Bloomberg Beta, First Round Capital, and more.

To see what we ship, watch the 2026 Stedi Keynote. To learn more about how we work, watch our founder Zack's interview with First Round Capital.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

Every month, millions of eligibility checks, claims, remittances, and claim statuses flow between healthcare providers and payers through our clearinghouse. Our Payer Strategy & Operations team is responsible for the health, growth, and operational efficiency of this system.

To help support and scale this system, we are hiring for our Revenue Cycle Strategy and Operations team. Your mandate is to leverage the data flowing through our clearinghouse to define and track key claims and revenue cycle metrics, eliminate operational toil, improve customer outcomes, enhance our product offering, and uncover payer performance trends across the ecosystem.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Develop and maintain edits:** Translate recurring rejections and errors into clear validation and repair rules through development, testing, deployment, and ongoing monitoring.
* **Define and track RCM health metrics:** Develop and maintain metrics such as claim acceptance rates, denial reasons, first-pass resolution rates, payer adjudication times etc. while identifying new measures as payer behavior and customer needs evolve.

* **Analyze payer performance:** Track payer-level performance (claim rejections, delay patterns, ERA discrepancies, eligibility response behavior) to surface trends and identify systemic issues impacting customers.

* **Create actionable reporting:** Build clear, high-signal dashboards and reports that enable Customer Operations, Payer Operations, and Product teams to proactively detect and resolve issues before customers are affected.

* **Drive claims & RCM insights:** Partner with Customer Operations, Sales, and Product to analyze claim flows, denial patterns, payer rules, and reimbursement behaviors that improve troubleshooting and inform product enhancements.

* **Document patterns and requirements:** Create and maintain a knowledge base of payer rules, recurring claim errors, eligibility and status bugs, and remittance behaviors to support faster and more accurate triage.

**Who you are**
---------------

* **You have deep RCM expertise.** You’re experienced in analyzing healthcare claims, claim status, and payer reimbursement data. You know the important metrics and why they matter.
* **You have exceptional analytics and documentation skills:** You treat claims analytics like an engineering discipline: defining clear metrics, validating data quality, building reproducible workflows and organizing complex logic into maintainable structures. You know what it takes to stand up a high-performing claims analytics function.
* **You know the tech stack.** You are an expert in SQL and fluent in modern visualization tools
* **You are excited about using new AI technologies.** You actively use emerging AI tools to improve analysis speed, automate workflows, enhance pattern detection, and expand the scope of what you can investigate.
* **You create and execute your own work.** You are relentlessly curious, and want to become an expert in the product and the overall operation so you can create and prove your own hypotheses. You are not satisfied in a role where someone hands you requirements.
* **You do what it takes to get the job done.** You are resourceful, self-motivating, self-disciplined, and don’t wait to be told what to do. You put in the hours.
* **You move quickly**. We move fast as an organization. You match our pace with urgency, crisp communication, and a willingness to escalate or ask for feedback when needed. You support both internal teams and payer-facing workflows with rapid, thoughtful analysis.
* **You are a “bottom feeder”.** You thrive on the details. No task is too small in order to find success, generate revenue, and improve our costs.

**We’ve been made aware of individuals impersonating the Stedi recruiting team.** Please note:

* All official communication about roles at Stedi will **only come from an @****stedi.com** **email address**, or from our official identification verification partner, Persona, @frompersona.com.
* If you’re unsure whether a message is legitimate or have any concerns, feel free to **contact us directly at** **careers@stedi.com****.**

We appreciate your attention to this and your interest in joining Stedi.

*At Stedi, we're looking for people who are deeply curious and aligned to our ways of working. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description.*

new_jobs.title: Office Manager / Receptionist (bilingual Spanish required)
new_jobs.description:
**Organization:** Compass Family Services is a 100+ year old nonprofit working on the front lines of San Francisco's homeless crisis. We provide families experiencing or at risk of homelessness with comprehensive support to address immediate needs and ensure long-term success.

**Program:** Holy Family Day Home offers a progressive, Reggio Emilia-inspired preschool curriculum which emphasizes individualized learning, self-exploration, play-oriented lessons, and child-initiated, teacher-led education. Daily activities include early literacy lessons, STEM learning, small classes in the art studio, and outdoor education in the community garden. These are all supported by our highly-qualified teaching staff and a wide variety of age-appropriate teaching tools.

**Schedule:** Monday – Friday, 37.5 hours per week. Daily schedule varies between 7:45 am – 5:00 pm based on Center needs.

**Location:** 299 Dolores St, San Francisco

**Organizational Core Competencies:** Accountable / Adaptable / Client-centered / Collaborative / Committed to diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging / Resourceful

**Responsibilities:**  
The primary duty of the Office Manager/Receptionist is to staff the front reception station of a large childcare center in the Mission District. The Office Manager/Receptionist is the first point of contact for families and other visitors. They greet families and children each morning, maintain the safety and security of our space, provide families with updates and resources, and provide administrative support to the management team. Specific job responsibilities include:

*Front Desk & Phone:*

* Greet all visitors as they enter the building.
* Answer calls and messages on the main phone line.
* Serve as the communication liaison between families and staff, relaying updates promptly and calling families to gather information as needed.
* Contact families about illness policies and when a child needs to be picked up due to illness or other emergencies.

*Attendance:*

* Support daily attendance, including morning/afternoon rosters, check-in, logging drop-off and pick-up times, and calling absent families.
* Maintain accurate attendance logs, and collect doctors' and parents' notes for monthly scanning and submission to the SFELA enrollment specialist.
* Track late drop-offs and late pick-ups against each family's contract hours.
* Verify authorized pick-up individuals, including ID checks and contacting families for authorization as needed.

*Records & Administration:*

* Enter data into CareConnect and other systems.
* Collect childcare fees.
* Assist teachers and administrative staff in collecting signatures from families on required documents in a timely manner.
* Provide clerical support, including sorting mail, contacting messenger services, copying, and filing.

*Facility:*

* Open the childcare center at 7:45 am and/or close center at 5:00 pm.
* Keep the lobby clean and well organized.
* Update and maintain bulletin boards with resources and information for families.
* Help stock office supplies as needed (e.g., paper, disinfectant).

**Qualifications:**

* **Fluent Spanish** **and** **English required**
* Demonstrated experience and ability to multi-task in a fast-paced front office environment
* One year of receptionist or similar customer service experience
* Experience in general office practices (filing, phones, typing, etc.).
* Computer literate including proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.
* Good organizational skills
* Good communication and interpersonal skills, ability to work and communicate with children and families and the general public in a busy setting.
* Good judgement, calm demeanor, and discretion with regard to sensitive information.
* Ability to interact with families and children with patience and in a positive, friendly manner
* Demonstrated commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging work.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* Salary: $30 - $33 per hour, 37.5 hours per week
* Paid time off: 4 weeks of vacation your first year, 5 in your second. Also paid holidays, sick time, family leave.
* Insurance: health, dental and vision insurance are fully covered by Compass for employees and dependent children. We also provide long term disability and life insurance.
* Retirement: after one year of work, Compass contributes an amount equal to 5% of your salary into a retirement account; this vests during years 2-6.
* Membership in OPEIU/Local 29 union

**To Apply:**

Please apply through our online application.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are an equal opportunity employer and actively seek to recruit a diverse workforce. Employees must embrace the idea that Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging contribute to the success of our underserved communities, and therefore to shared prosperity in our city and region. Compass Family Services is committed to the continuous work of implementing specific actions that will disrupt systemic prejudice and improve equity across programs and departments, to become an example to partners who also believe in a culture of inclusion that leverages diversity.

Consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act and California civil rights law, Compass Family Services will provide reasonable accommodation when requested by a qualified applicant or candidate with a disability, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship for the agency. Requests for reasonable accommodation apply to all aspects of the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please use the answer box for the final question of the job application to let us know.

  + Manages and maintains good human resources practices with direct reports, and adherence to established corporate and department policies and procedures

  + Ensures the safe, clean and efficient operation of the warehouse to meet service standards

  + Follows documented processes for reporting, analyzing, and following up on employee injuries and accidents.

new_jobs.title: Case Manager II
new_jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY**: The Case Manager II (CM II), a key member of the primary care interdisciplinary team, provides services for patients with complex care needs. This position conducts patient outreach, engagement and psychosocial service assessment, assists in developing a patient-centered care plan, is the lead implementer of Enhanced Care Management (ECM) and coordinates service referrals and delivery. The Case Manager meets clients in home, clinic, or community as appropriate or required by the specific program/site. The CM II provides services to specific populations that have multiple complex health and social services needs and often provides care outside of a traditional health center setting, such as home visits, hospitals, supportive housing sites, encampments and shelters.

This position is represented by SEIU-UHW. Salaries and benefits are set by a collective bargaining agreement (CBA), and an employee in this position must remain a member in good standing of SEIU-UHW, as defined in the CBA.

**About us:**

As a Federally Qualified Health Center in Northern California with over 50 years of dedicated service to the community, LifeLong serves over 66,000 patients in the East Bay Area's socio-economically underserved regions. We provide medical, dental, behavioral health, and school-based services at more than 15 primary care sites across Oakland, Berkeley, and West Contra Costa County. From opening a residential respite program for homeless persons discharged from hospital to offering free testing to the community, we are innovative and responsive to our times' social and medical needs. We provide an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity and with which our patients can identify. To this end, we seek candidates who reflect the diversity of the East Bay communities we serve.

**Benefits:**

We offer excellent benefits: medical, dental, vision, Flexible Spending Accounts, dependent and domestic partner coverage, 403(b) retirement savings plan, and paid time off.

**Essential Functions**:

* Outreach, via telephone and in person at LifeLong, community and residential sites, to patients who meet case management program eligibility criteria or are prioritized by LifeLong for this service
* Proactively meet and engage with patients to build effective relationships and assess strengths and needs through use of standard intake, screening tools, and health, and social services records review
* Actively involve patients and caregivers, as appropriate, in designing and delivering services, including development of care plans, assuring alignment with patients’ values and expressed goals of care
* Provide and facilitate referrals for internal and external resources, and collaborate with the patient to complete required applications, forms, or releases of information
* Maintain a patient caseload in accordance with LifeLong standards for the specific population served or site requirements
* Utilize data registries and reports to manage caseload, meet program requirements, maintain grant deliverables, and promote high quality care
* Provide health education and training to patients, including but not limited to, harm reduction and disease risk-mitigation strategies that empower patients to manage their own health and wellness (e.g. overdose prevention, mitigating spread of communicable diseases)

new_jobs.title: Robotaxi Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**What to Expect**

Tesla continues to scale at breakneck speed aligned with our mission to accelerate the world’s transition to sustainable energy. At Tesla, our Operations Managers are the front-line leaders of our Service, Delivery, Collision, and other operations. They manage day-to-day operations and proactively develop team members to reach their full potential. Our Operations Managers consistently deliver excellent results across all aspects of the business: customer satisfaction, people leadership, operations, and financials.

To facilitate the growth of our Robotaxi program, the North America Service Operations team is seeking a dynamic problem solver with exceptional ability to challenge us to think differently. The right person is hungry to dive into critical challenges, breaking down silos and partnering closely with cross-functional teams across Tesla to drive the business forward, while building an all-star team to maintain our Robotaxi fleet.

 **What You'll Do**

* Lead by example, prioritize team success, and actively engage in team growth and development, providing regular feedback and mentoring
* Monitor service trends and develop standards and processes to maintain the uptime of the Robotaxi fleet
* Understand and improve all aspects Robotaxi Service performance, championing safety, efficiency, quality, and technical acumen in Service operations
* Lead daily operations, from Service to cleaning to managing our Lost and Found process
* Embrace change, excel in high-pressure situations, exhibit strong prioritization and time management skills, and combine analytical thinking with hands-on problem-solving and a customer-service mindset
* Act in the best interest of Tesla, advocate for customers and team success, and demonstrate a passion for Tesla's mission, people, and customers
* Coordinate across the market and other teams at Tesla to remove blockers to the growth of the Robotaxi program

  
**What You'll Bring**

* Strong and proven experience leading field, technical repair, or manufacturing teams in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment with strong problem-solving skills
* Experience leading teams and managing a diverse group of roles and responsibilities
* Analytical mindset and courage to question the status quo – ability to ask structured questions and quantify impact if you recognize an opportunity to improve
* Low ego and hunger to learn, able to connect with anyone and roll up your sleeves to do whatever is needed to help the team
* Relentless drive for excellence that stands out among peers, regardless of background
* Experience running complex processes using Lean or other techniques
* Ability to influence and build relationships without authority, from front-line technicians to executive leadership

#### **Benefits**

Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:

* Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
* Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
* Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
* Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
* Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits

* Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
* Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
* Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
* Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
* Tesla Babies program
* Commuter benefits
* Employee discounts and perks program
* Earned Wage Access: Real-time pay access paid daily, subject to eligibility and schedule (applicable for below Sr. Managers levels)

$128,000 - $192,000/annual salary + cash and stock awards + benefits

new_jobs.description:
Office Manager

**Timberline Roofing Solutions – Pleasanton, CA**

**Pay:** $30–$40 per hour (depending on experience)

**Job Type:** Full-Time | In-Person

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM

About the Opportunity

Timberline Roofing Solutions is an established roofing company serving the Bay Area. We're looking for an experienced, highly motivated Office Manager to become an important part of our growing team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys taking initiative, solving problems, and keeping a busy operation running smoothly.

We're looking for more than someone who can manage administrative tasks. We want a positive, confident, and organized professional who takes ownership of their work, anticipates needs, and makes things happen.

You'll play a key role in coordinating our office operations, communicating with customers, managing schedules, and keeping our field crews and internal team organized.

If you're someone who thrives on responsibility, enjoys working with people, and takes pride in getting things done, we'd love to meet you.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage daily office operations and maintain an organized, efficient workflow.
* Answer incoming phone calls and respond to customer emails professionally and promptly.
* Coordinate roofing inspections, service appointments, repairs, and field crew schedules.
* Communicate with field technicians, project managers, and internal team members to ensure jobs stay on schedule.
* Handle scheduling conflicts, urgent service requests, and changing daily priorities.
* Track customer inquiries, pending tasks, and follow-ups to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
* Maintain accurate customer information, job records, and schedules using CRM and office management software.
* Proactively identify operational issues and help implement improvements to office procedures.
* Independently resolve routine problems while escalating significant decisions to ownership.
* Build positive relationships with customers, coworkers, and field personnel.

What We're Looking For

The right person will bring a combination of strong organizational skills, excellent communication, and a genuinely positive attitude.

**Our ideal candidate is:**

* **Proactive and Self-Motivated:** Takes initiative, anticipates needs, and follows through without constant supervision.
* **Positive and Personable:** Brings great energy to the office and enjoys interacting with customers and coworkers.
* **Highly Organized:** Comfortable managing multiple schedules, priorities, and responsibilities simultaneously.
* **Confident and Resourceful:** Able to make decisions, solve problems, and keep things moving in a busy environment.
* **An Excellent Communicator:** Professional, friendly, and clear when communicating with customers and field teams.
* **Accountable and Dependable:** Takes ownership of responsibilities and consistently follows through.
* **Team-Oriented:** Enjoys collaborating with a small team and contributing to a positive workplace culture.

Qualifications

* 3+ years of experience in office management, operations coordination, scheduling, dispatching, or a similar role preferred.
* Experience in roofing, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, construction, restoration, or another service-based industry is highly desirable.
* Experience coordinating field crews, technicians, or service appointments is a strong plus.
* Excellent customer service, written communication, and phone skills.
* Strong organizational, multitasking, and problem-solving abilities.
* Proficiency with email, scheduling software, Microsoft Office, and CRM systems.
* Ability to work independently and maintain composure when priorities change.

**Roofing experience is not required.** We value strong leadership qualities, initiative, organization, and a great attitude above specific industry experience.

Why Join Timberline Roofing Solutions?

We believe great people are the foundation of a successful business.

As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on how our company operates and contribute to our continued growth.

**Why Timberline:**

* By joining Timberline you will have an immeidate impact on the growth of the company. Everyone here plays an integral part of making a real daily impact.
* There is tremendous room for growth as we are in an acceleration period.
* In the world today, everyone wants to work remotely but we lose that team feeling. Working at Timberline you will have the support of a team again.

**\*\*Before You Apply:\*\* We ask that you carefully consider whether this position is the right fit for you. We're looking for someone who is ready to step in, take initiative, and make an immediate impact on our daily operations. This is an important role within our company, and we need someone who is reliable, accountable, and committed to following through on their responsibilities. We have high expectations and are looking for someone who takes their work seriously, can be counted on, and is ready to contribute from day one. If that is you, we are extremley eager to talk with you.**

Pay: $30.00 - $40.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Product Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Why Join Doppel**

Doppel is building the future of social engineering defense. Our AI-native platform uses agentic AI to protect executives, employees, customers, and brands from phishing, impersonation, fraud, and other AI-powered threats across digital channels. We help some of the world’s most recognized brands detect and dismantle attacker infrastructure while strengthening employee resilience through threat-informed training and simulation. By unifying Digital Risk Protection, Human Risk Management and Email Security, Doppel connects threats into a real-time intelligence graph to power faster disruption, smarter defense, and modern security awareness at scale.

Backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz and Bessemer Venture Partners, and trusted by leading enterprises, Doppel is a rapidly growing Series C startup building the future of social engineering defense. Our team combines deep cybersecurity expertise, operational rigor, and startup velocity to solve some of the internet’s most urgent trust and safety challenges.

**What We're Building**

We're building the AI-native social engineering defense platform.

This means we're designing scalable systems that monitor billions of domains, social media accounts, apps, dark web forums, etc., and leverage AI agents to identify and neutralize digital threats.

**What We're Looking For**

We're looking for a Product Operations Engineer who can drive operational excellence across Product, Engineering, Data/ML, and Customer teams to help scale an AI-native security platform. You'll turn ambiguous problems into repeatable processes, improve how products are built and launched, surface insights from data and customers, and ensure teams have the operational foundation to execute quickly.

* Proven track record improving cross-functional product operations and driving strategic initiatives in fast-moving environments
* Strong analytical and technical fluency (SQL, APIs, product analytics, data pipelines, ML concepts) to identify opportunities, measure outcomes, and inform product decisions
* Excellent at designing scalable processes for roadmap planning, product launches, feedback loops, prioritization, and cross-functional execution
* Relentless about operational excellence: identifies bottlenecks, streamlines workflows, and enables Product and Engineering teams to move faster
* Metrics-driven: defines KPIs, builds dashboards, synthesizes customer and business insights, and ensures product decisions are backed by data
* Clear, direct communicator who aligns Product, Engineering, Go-to-Market, and Leadership around priorities, execution, and measurable business outcomes

This version reflects what high-performing Product Operations leaders at AI startups typically own: improving execution, creating scalable processes, enabling product teams with data and insights, and ensuring successful product delivery rather than directly managing engineering programs.

**What We Offer**

A mission-driven culture with low ego, high ownership, deep customer obsession, and exceptional talent density

Free lunch and dinner in the office

Flexible PTO

Quarterly team offsites

**Join Doppel**
===============

Doppel is the first platform built to dismantle digital deception at scale. We scan over 150 billion entities daily and deploy continuously adaptive AI SOC agents, paired with expert human analysts, to uncover and disrupt the infrastructure behind phishing, impersonation, and online fraud before attacks can spread. Our Threat Grid turns every customer signal into shared intelligence, making each disruption smarter, faster, and more effective.

We’re not just another cybersecurity company. We’re defining the future of social engineering defense, where trust is protected, and deception becomes unprofitable. Backed by top-tier investors and trusted by some of the world’s most recognized brands, Doppel is growing fast. If you’re driven to solve real-world problems with bold technology, we’d love to meet you.

Compensation Range: $180K - $230K

new_jobs.title: Temp Creative Project Manager – Emerging Brands
new_jobs.description:
**ABOUT KENDO**

Kendo Holdings, Inc. is a San Francisco-based beauty brand developer and wholesaler owned by LVMH Moët Hennessy - Louis Vuitton, the world’s largest luxury group. A play on the words “can do”, Kendo has become the hub of creativity and next generation beauty product development for global Sephora channels and selective retailers outside of Sephora.

Through original development, collaborations and acquisitions the Kendo stable of brands will always be creative, inspiring and innovative. A dynamic engine of speed, expertise and market-savvy, the Kendo team continues to redefine the beauty industry through great product, great storytelling, great retail and direct-to-consumer partnerships. This shows up in everything we do and in what we stand for:

* “Can Do” Spirit: We work together to make our wildest dreams a reality: As entrepreneurs, we embrace optimism and find creative ways to reach our goals
* Advocacy, Diversity, and Inclusion: We recognize and celebrate the full spectrum of personal identities. We create safe spaces so everyone’s voice is heard. We listen with humility and act with courage.
* Storytelling: We tell authentic stories like no, one else. It’s our key to inspire trust and build relationships, rallying, our people, partners, and consumers around our brands.
* Resilience: We embrace challenges as opportunities. Change is ever- constant, and agility is our strength.
* Product Excellence: We put the consumers first: We constantly raise the bar to create products of the highest quality that everyone just has to have.
  

The salary range for this temp position is $43.30 - $56.00 per hour. Offered salary is dependent upon experience and San Francisco location. This is a hybrid role based in our downtown San Francisco office – Tues through Thursday in-office, with Monday and Friday remote.

  

The Kendo house of brands currently includes: Fenty Beauty, Fenty Skin, Fenty Eau de Parfum, Fenty Hair, Ole Henriksen, Lip Lab.

  

**SUMMARY**

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Project Manager to join our creative team, supporting the Emerging Brands (Ole Henriksen & Lip Lab) divisions. This role is critical in ensuring the successful and timely execution of all creative projects. You’ll own GTM and digital timelines for the brands, serving as the creative team’s primary point of contact for print and digital projects. While embedded within the creative team due to the significant creative input required for most projects, this individual will be instrumental in fostering seamless collaboration between brand, marketing, and creative departments to ensure all initiatives launch on schedule with all necessary assets.

This role for creative Project Manager is a temporary position.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Partner with stakeholders across brand, marketing, and creative teams to define project scopes, establish timelines, and manage project lifecycles within Asana.
* Efficiently manage project intake and conversion processes within Workfront.
* Drive projects forward, proactively identifying and mitigating risks to ensure deadlines are met.
* Lead and facilitate weekly creative status, review and project kickoff meetings.
* Accurately capture, distribute, and follow up on meeting notes, action items, and other critical inter-team communications.
* Successfully manage a diverse portfolio of concurrent digital projects across multiple brands.
* Continuously identify opportunities for process improvements and workflow optimization to enhance team efficiency and project delivery.
  

**REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor’s degree
* 5+ years of progressive project management experience, with a strong preference for digital project management within a creative or marketing environment.
* Expert-level proficiency in project management software, including Asana and Adobe Creative Suite (specifically ProofHQ and Workfront).
* Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships and effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and diverse stakeholders.
* Exceptional organizational skills with a keen eye for detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* PMP Certification is a plus.

We help Lam deliver industry-leading solutions with speed and efficiency, while actively supporting the resilient and profitable growth of Lam's business.

Since our launch in 2017, we’ve helped major financial institutions and tech-savvy trailblazers alike (e.g. Plaid, Raymond James, Crypto.com etc.) orchestrate their compliance programs through our thoughtfully designed, intuitive, AI powered compliance tools. We believe finding and stopping financial crime is a problem rooted in code, language and design, so we built the product that the heroes doing this work deserve.

We are customer-obsessed, and we love building and shipping great products. We set a high bar, challenge our assumptions, seek diverse opinions, and support each other to do our best work.

We do our best to write inclusive, descriptive and accurate job descriptions, but we’re not always perfect. If you’re interested in the role, **we’d love to hear from you even if you don’t feel like you meet everything we’re looking for**. As an Implementation Manager (Contractor), you’ll be the engine behind successful customer launches at Hummingbird. This contract role, working roughly 20 hours per week, will be responsible for implementations end-to-end — translating real customer business and technical requirements into a thoughtfully configured Hummingbird platform that meets our clients’ use cases.

**About BLACK LABEL**

BLACK LABEL is a white-glove procurement, design and technical-support partner for commercial cultivators and extraction labs across North America. As a 100% B2B company, we supply multi-state operators, single-state cultivators and extraction labs with everything from lighting, irrigation, fertigation, airflow, racking, substrates and IPM to extraction equipment and solvents, and we help them design and build out their facilities. Our customers count on us for a VIP experience: expert guidance, precision and follow-through on every order. We are a small, highly committed team that runs on responsiveness, accountability and customer-first thinking.

**The Role**

We are hiring a Commercial Account Manager (CAM) to own and grow a book of commercial accounts. You will own each relationship end to end, including service, retention and account health, and you carry responsibility for growing revenue and gross profit in that book, alongside new business you develop yourself. This is a fully remote, full-time role, Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time.

This is a sales-led role. It is a strong fit for someone who is consultative, commercially minded and motivated by an uncapped commission, and who still makes every customer feel taken care of. You do not need to be a cultivation or extraction expert on day one. Experience in the industry is a real advantage.

**What You Will Do**

* Own the commercial relationship for every account in your assigned book
* Grow revenue and gross profit within that book through deeper penetration of existing accounts, and develop new commercial accounts, including reactivating dormant ones
* Work through customers' facility requirements, such as expansions, retrofits, environmental control and fertigation performance, and specify the equipment and system design that solves them
* Set customer pricing at your own discretion above the company's gross margin floor, and convert quotes to live orders
* Select which vendors and manufacturers to source a project from, and negotiate cost with them
* Commit the company on lead times and delivery dates to your customers
* Work with our vendor and manufacturer partners on availability and technical support
* Maintain account health through responsiveness, issue resolution and proactive service
* Keep accurate records in Zoho CRM, Zoho Projects and Zoho Desk, and follow company SOPs
* Represent BLACK LABEL as the single point of accountability for your customers

**What We Are Looking For**

* 3+ years in B2B account management, consultative or inside sales, or a similar role where you owned relationships and grew revenue
* A consultative communicator who builds trust easily and is comfortable negotiating on price and cost
* Strong organisation and attention to detail. You can run multiple accounts, quotes and open orders without letting anything slip
* Comfort with business software. Experience with a CRM (Zoho, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar) is a plus
* Self-motivated and dependable in a fully remote environment, with excellent written and verbal communication
* Experience in Controlled Environment Agriculture, horticulture, cannabis, extraction, or a related supply or procurement field is a strong plus

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Base salary of $70,000 per year
* Uncapped commission on the gross profit growth you generate: 15% on the first $70,000 of commissionable gross profit each calendar year, 20% on the next $70,000, and 25% on everything above $140,000. Full new-account gross profit is commissioned from the first dollar

* 7 paid company holidays, plus 3 days of bereavement leave
* Fully remote, open to candidates anywhere in the United States

This is a full-time, salaried, exempt position. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. Black Label Supply LLC (dba BLACK LABEL) is an equal opportunity employer.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
Eaton’s ES AMER Sector Integration division is currently seeking a Customer Success Manager.

The expected annual salary range for this role is $146000 - $215000 a year. This position is also eligible for a variable incentive program.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

**What you’ll do:**
-------------------

Eaton's Digital Office is seeking a Customer Success Manager to support our expanding portfolio of Brightlayer software solutions. This role will orchestrate the post-sale customer journey, helping customers realize measurable value from Brightlayer solutions while driving adoption, retention, renewal readiness, and expansion opportunities.

Because the Brightlayer customer success capability is still in an early stage of maturity, this is not a purely run-the-playbook CSM role. The successful candidate will be expected to manage customer relationships while also helping build the operating model: scalable lifecycle motions, renewal-readiness practices, account health reporting, Voice of Customer loops, playbooks, and technology-enabled engagement approaches.

The ideal candidate is a senior, data-driven customer success professional who combines trusted-advisor customer skills with operational rigor, commercial awareness, comfort with AI-enabled tools, and the ability to influence across a matrixed organization. This person should be equally comfortable engaging directly with customers, partnering with Sales and Product, and helping define how Brightlayer customer success should scale over time.

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

**Customer Adoption and Value Realization**  

* Facilitate the post-sale customer journey across onboarding, training, adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion support.
* Develop customer success plans that align Brightlayer capabilities to customer objectives, expected outcomes, stakeholders, and adoption milestones.
* Drive adoption through proactive customer engagement, use case reviews, release awareness, business check-ins, and practical guidance on relevant Brightlayer functionality.

**Retention, Renewal Readiness, and Growth**  

* Monitor customer health across adoption, engagement, satisfaction, support trends, renewal timing, stakeholder alignment, and relationship quality.
* Develop renewal-readiness plans with Sales and Commercial Operations to support retention, reduce churn risk, and improve forecast predictability.
* Identify customer success risks and expansion opportunities early, then coordinate cross-functional action plans to protect outcomes and support growth.

**Tech-Touch, Digital Engagement, and AI-Enabled Scale**  

* Help define tech-touch, digital-touch, automated, and AI-assisted engagement models that scale customer success beyond high-touch coverage.
* Contribute to the evaluation, implementation, and optimization of a customer success platform and supporting digital workflows.
* Use AI-enabled capabilities responsibly to improve customer insights, account prioritization, health scoring, renewal risk detection, communications, and repeatable CS workflows.

**Customer Insights and Voice of Customer**  

* Capture customer feedback, business needs, product gaps, and emerging market requirements to serve as an internal advocate for Brightlayer customers.
* Share actionable Voice of Customer insights with Product, Offer Management, Support, Services, Sales, and Commercial Operations to inform roadmap, service, and customer experience improvements.

**Operations, Analytics, and Process Excellence**  

* Track customer success metrics, including adoption, renewal rate, churn risk, customer health, engagement, satisfaction, and value realization.
* Use CRM, customer success tools, dashboards, and analytics to prioritize accounts, identify risks, and inform business recommendations.
* Support the development of customer success processes, playbooks, reporting standards, health-scoring approaches, and operating rhythms.
* Provide regular reporting and insights to leadership on customer health, adoption trends, renewal readiness, and customer success performance.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**  

* Collaborate with Product, Solutions Architects, Professional Services, Customer Support, Offer Management, Commercial Operations, and Sales to coordinate customer outcomes.
* Ensure customer expectations, requirements, and deliverables are clearly understood across internal teams.
* Influence cross-functional stakeholders to remove barriers, accelerate customer outcomes, and improve the overall Brightlayer customer experience.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

**Basic Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in customer success, account management, commercial operations, customer operations, SaaS, product, or technology-driven customer-facing roles.
* Minimum 5 years of experience working in a B2B software, services, technology, or digital solutions environment.
* Minimum 5 years of experience with customer relationship management systems or customer success tools.
* No relocation is offered for this role.
* Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.

  
  
**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Experience in Enterprise SaaS, industrial software, energy management, power management, electrical infrastructure, digital transformation, or connected solutions.
* Experience developing customer success processes, playbooks, health scoring model

new_jobs.title: Revenue Cycle Strategy & Operations
new_jobs.description:
**Location**
------------

Remote in the USA

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Location Type**
-----------------

Remote

**Department**
--------------

Strategy & Operations

  

**We're building a new healthcare clearinghouse**
=================================================

Stedi is the only headless clearinghouse and RCM engine. Headless means every part of our product is accessible via API. Developers and AI agents build their own interface on top of it. By offering modern, AI-ready APIs alongside traditional real-time and batch EDI processes, we enable both healthcare technology businesses and established players to exchange mission-critical transactions. Our clearinghouse product and customer-first approach have set us apart. Stedi was ranked by Ramp as one of the fastest-growing SaaS vendors.

Stedi has lightning in a bottle: engineers and designers shipping products week in and week out; a lean business team supporting the company's infrastructure; a passion for automation and eliminating toil; and $142 million in funding from top investors like Stripe, Addition, USV, Bloomberg Beta, First Round Capital, and more.

To see what we ship, watch the 2026 Stedi Keynote. To learn more about how we work, watch our founder Zack's interview with First Round Capital.

**What we’re looking for**
--------------------------

Every month, millions of eligibility checks, claims, remittances, and claim statuses flow between healthcare providers and payers through our clearinghouse. Our Payer Strategy & Operations team is responsible for the health, growth, and operational efficiency of this system.

To help support and scale this system, we are hiring for our Revenue Cycle Strategy and Operations team. Your mandate is to leverage the data flowing through our clearinghouse to define and track key claims and revenue cycle metrics, eliminate operational toil, improve customer outcomes, enhance our product offering, and uncover payer performance trends across the ecosystem.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Develop and maintain edits:** Translate recurring rejections and errors into clear validation and repair rules through development, testing, deployment, and ongoing monitoring.
* **Define and track RCM health metrics:** Develop and maintain metrics such as claim acceptance rates, denial reasons, first-pass resolution rates, payer adjudication times etc. while identifying new measures as payer behavior and customer needs evolve.

* **Analyze payer performance:** Track payer-level performance (claim rejections, delay patterns, ERA discrepancies, eligibility response behavior) to surface trends and identify systemic issues impacting customers.

* **Create actionable reporting:** Build clear, high-signal dashboards and reports that enable Customer Operations, Payer Operations, and Product teams to proactively detect and resolve issues before customers are affected.

* **Drive claims & RCM insights:** Partner with Customer Operations, Sales, and Product to analyze claim flows, denial patterns, payer rules, and reimbursement behaviors that improve troubleshooting and inform product enhancements.

* **Document patterns and requirements:** Create and maintain a knowledge base of payer rules, recurring claim errors, eligibility and status bugs, and remittance behaviors to support faster and more accurate triage.

**Who you are**
---------------

* **You have deep RCM expertise.** You’re experienced in analyzing healthcare claims, claim status, and payer reimbursement data. You know the important metrics and why they matter.
* **You have exceptional analytics and documentation skills:** You treat claims analytics like an engineering discipline: defining clear metrics, validating data quality, building reproducible workflows and organizing complex logic into maintainable structures. You know what it takes to stand up a high-performing claims analytics function.
* **You know the tech stack.** You are an expert in SQL and fluent in modern visualization tools
* **You are excited about using new AI technologies.** You actively use emerging AI tools to improve analysis speed, automate workflows, enhance pattern detection, and expand the scope of what you can investigate.
* **You create and execute your own work.** You are relentlessly curious, and want to become an expert in the product and the overall operation so you can create and prove your own hypotheses. You are not satisfied in a role where someone hands you requirements.
* **You do what it takes to get the job done.** You are resourceful, self-motivating, self-disciplined, and don’t wait to be told what to do. You put in the hours.
* **You move quickly**. We move fast as an organization. You match our pace with urgency, crisp communication, and a willingness to escalate or ask for feedback when needed. You support both internal teams and payer-facing workflows with rapid, thoughtful analysis.
* **You are a “bottom feeder”.** You thrive on the details. No task is too small in order to find success, generate revenue, and improve our costs.

**We’ve been made aware of individuals impersonating the Stedi recruiting team.** Please note:

* All official communication about roles at Stedi will **only come from an @****stedi.com** **email address**, or from our official identification verification partner, Persona, @frompersona.com.
* If you’re unsure whether a message is legitimate or have any concerns, feel free to **contact us directly at** **careers@stedi.com****.**

We appreciate your attention to this and your interest in joining Stedi.

*At Stedi, we're looking for people who are deeply curious and aligned to our ways of working. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match the job description.*
